This can become a giant crop! |Energy = No Star: +75, Silver: +105, Gold: +135 |Health = No Star: +30, Silver: +42, Gold: +54 |Crop Pierre Sell = No Star: 175g, Silver: 218g, Gold: 262g |image = Cauliflower.png |alt = Cauliflower |Crop Sell = 175g |Seed Pierre Buy = 80g |Crop Joja Buy = None |Seed Joja Buy = None }} Cauliflower is a [[Crops|crop]] in Stardew Valley. They can be grown during the spring and take 12 days to mature. You can sell them through the shipping container for No Star: 175g, Silver: 218g, Gold: 262g each.
This crop has a chance of becoming a giant crop every day if it is placed in a 3x3 pattern and keeps being watered when it's full-grown. It then can be harvested with an axe yielding double quantity.
This crop is used in: Spring Crops Bundle and Cheese Cauliflower recipe.

Grows on a trellis. |Seed Cost = |Seed Pierre Buy = 60g |Seed Joja Buy = 75g |Description = A juicy little bean with a cool, crisp snap. |Energy = No Star: +25, Silver: +35, Gold: +45 |Health = No Star: +10, Silver: +14, Gold: +18 |Crop Pierre Sell = No Star: 40g, Silver: 50g, Gold: 60g |image = Green Bean.png }} The '''Green Bean''' is a [[crop]] in Stardew Valley. They can be grown during the [[Spring]] and take 10 days to mature and keeps producing after 3 days. They sell through the [[shipping bin]] for 40g, 50g at silver [[quality]], and 60g at gold.
Planted green beans cannot be walked through, requiring the player to walk around the crop. The Green Bean does not yield multiple beans per harvest despite the tool-tip on the seed packet item stating that they do.

{{Infobox crops |Name = Strawberry |image = Strawberry.png |alt = Strawberry |Release = February 26, 2016 |Growth = 8 days (Keeps producing after 4 days) |Season = Spring |Seed Name = Strawberry Seeds |Seed Description = Plant these in the spring at the Egg Festival. Takes 8 days to mature, and keeps producing strawberries after that. |Seed Cost = 100G |Energy = No Star: +50, Silver: +70, Gold: +90 |Health = No Star: +20, Silver: +28, Gold: +36 |Crop Sell = 120G |Description = Juicy sweet fruit that provides a good amount of cash because it keeps growing! |Crop Pierre Sell = No Star: 120g, Silver: 150g, Gold: 180g |Seed Pierre Buy = Egg Festival 100g |Seed Joja Buy = Egg Festival 100g }} {{tocright}} {{Stub}} [[File:Strawberry Growth.png|thumb|link=]] '''Strawberries''' are a [[crop]] in [[Stardew Valley]]. [[Strawberry seeds]] can purchased from a [[shop]] during the [[Egg Festival]] or from [[Oasis]] in the [[Calico Desert]]. They can be grown during [[Spring]] and take 8 days to mature and will keep producing fruit after 4 days. They sell through the [[shipping bin]] for 120g, 150g at silver [[quality]], and 180g at gold quality. Strawberry [[Jelly]] sells for 290g each. Strawberry [[Wine]] sells for 360g.
== Growing == Strawberries can be grown by planting [[strawberry seeds]] and watering them for 8 days. After harvest, strawberries will continue to grow from the original plant until the end of the [[season]].

{{Infobox crops |Name = Hops |image = hops.png |alt = Hop |Release = February 26, 2016 |Growth = 11 Days (Keeps producing everyday) |Season = Summer |Seed Name = Hops Starter |Seed Description = Plant these in the summer. Takes 11 days to produce. |Description = A bitter, tangy flower used to flavor beer. |Energy = No Star: +45, Silver: +63, Gold: +81 |Health = No Star: +18, Silver: +25, Gold: +32 |Crop Pierre Sell = No Star: 25g, Silver: 31g, Gold: 37g |Seed Pierre Buy = 60g }} Hops are a crop in Stardew Valley. They can be grown during the Summer and take 11 days to mature and keeps producing everyday. They sell through the shipping container for No Star: 25g, Silver: 31g, Gold: 37g each.
You cannot walk through hops at any stage of growth.
== Used In: == * Pale Ale == Notes == Hops do have a special way of growing, after reaching the matured state hops will be grown each day making it a vital source for creating pale ale with the use of a [[keg]]. Pale ale sells for 300g or for 420g if the players chooses the artisan talent upon reaching max farming skill; so hops generate a lot of money when grown in bulk in combination with brewing.
While it is possible to make a tidy profit by selling the raw fruit if you can set up a large amount of kegs you will be able to produce pale ale year round using your stockpiles.

[[Category:Gameplay]] [[Category:Crops]] At the start of each day, every possible 3x3 grid of crops (including overlaps) has a 1% chance to grow into a giant crop as long as the center crop is fully-grown and watered, and all constituent crops are of the same type. Giant crops won't necessarily appear on the day the crops finish growing; it can happen any day those criteria are met.
<nowiki>***</nowiki>0 = [[Cauliflower]] (Spring), [[Melon]] (Summer) or [[Pumpkin]] (Fall)*** {| class="fandom-table" !0 !0 !0 |- |0 |0 |0 |- |0 |0 |0 |} Giant Crops can be harvested by using [[Axe]] and yield double quantity.

{{Stub}} '''Tea Leaves''' are a [[crop]] harvested from [[Tea Sapling]]s in [[Spring]], [[Summer]], and [[Fall]], as well as [[Winter]] when planted indoors using [[Garden Pots]] or the [[Greenhouse]].
A Tea Sapling is given after completing [[Caroline's]] 2nd [[friendship]] event, as well as the [[Seed Maker]] crafting recipe. They take 20 days to mature and can be harvested every day on the last week of each month (days 22 through 28, for a total of 7 leaves). Tea Saplings don't die between [[season]] changes, and will continue to grow outdoors in Winter but wont produce any leaves.
== Usage == Tea leaves can be placed in a [[Keg]] to make [[Green Tea]], whch restores 5 Health, 13 Energy, and gives a +30 increase to maximum energy.

One of the perks of living here. Enjoy it, kid!" '''Dance of the Moonlight Jellies''' *"Don't tell Gus, but I'm a little disappointed there's no buffet tonight." '''Festival of Ice''' *"I plan on winning the ice fishing competition! [[Willy]] is going to be pretty hard to beat, though...He does this kinda stuff day and night." == Event == '''3 Hearts''' After gaining 3 hearts with Pam you will receive a recipe in the mail '''7 Hearts''' After gaining 7 hearts with Pam you will receive a recipe in the mail == Quest == '''Pam is Thirsty''' Tutorial video: https://youtu.be/dk_i3E2rPx0 == Portraits ==

However, your fate is ultimately in your own hands." |location = Cindersap Forest |address = Wizard's Tower |family = [[File:Witch Icon.png|20px|link=]] [[Witch]] (Ex-Wife) |friends = [[File:Dwarf Icon.png|20px|link=]] [[Dwarf]]

{{Item|Purple Mushroom}}
{{Item|Solar Essence}}
{{Item|Super Cucumber}}
{{Item|Void Essence}} |uhates = {{Item|Slime}} }} {{tocright}} The '''Wizard''' is a non-marriage [[Villager]] who resides in the [[Wizard's Tower]] in the south west part of [[Stardew Valley (location)|Stardew Valley]] in [[Cindersap Forest]]. After visiting the Craft Room's scroll, he will send a letter the next day addressing the 'rat problem' and telling the player to come to his tower. Entering the tower after reading the letter activates a cutscene where he proclaim his titles and gives the farmer the ability to read the junimos' language. https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Forest_Magic The Wizard's actual name is Rasmodius. == Daily Routine == Does not leave his tower, except for the festivals, when he likes to spy from afar. Unlike most villagers, the Wizard will never visit the [[Ginger Island]] Beach Resort.https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Wizard ==Family== He said one of the people in town is his daughter but the details of who this is, is still unclear. * He was once married to a witch who, after they broke up, went across the land cursing things in anger. Sometimes during the night, the witch will curse your coop, changing one of your chicken's eggs to a void egg. * Caroline says she used to visit the wizard but not to tell her husband or he will be jealous, so it is possible that Abigail could be his daughter. Or Caroline could be the Wizard's daughter, as his age is ambiguous. (Caroline refers to Abigail's original hair color as chestnut brown. So she could easily be Pierre's. Although Pierre is worried that he isn't Abigail's biological father. However, Abigail says she never has to dye her hair purple. It's stayed that color for as long as she remembers.) * Speculation his daughter could be the late Mona (see gravestone). Abigail being a noted character to spend various amounts of time at her grave. * Additional speculation that his daughter is Jas, who shares the same hair color. ==Gifts== ==='''Love'''=== "Ahh, this is imbued with potent arcane energies. It's very useful for my studies. Thank you!" [[Purple Mushroom]], [[Rabbit's Foot]], [[Solar Essence]], [[Void Essence]] ==='''Like'''=== "Many thanks. This item has some very interesting properties." [[Amethyst]], [[Apple]], [[Apricot]], [[Beer]], [[Blackberry Cobbler]], [[Blue Jazz]], [[Bok Choy]], [[Cauliflower]], [[Cherry]], [[Cheese]], [[Chocolate Cake]], [[Cloth]], [[Coffee]], [[Cookies]], [[Corn]], [[Cranberry Sauce]], [[Crocus]], [[Diamond]], [[Duck Mayonnaise]], [[Earth Crystal]], [[Eggplant]], [[Emerald]], [[Fiddlehead Fern]], [[Frozen Tear]], [[Ice Cream]], [[Jade]], [[Jelly]] ([[Blackberry]], [[Salmonberry]]), [[Maple Syrup]], [[Mayonnaise]], [[Nekoite]], [[Pale Ale]], [[Pickle]]d ([[Tomato]], [[Eggplant]]), [[Pizza]], [[Potato]], [[Parsnip]], [[Quartz]], [[Cactus Fruit]], [[Coconut]], [[Coral]], [[Cranberry]], [[Duck Feather]], [[Hops]], [[Hot Pepper]], [[Melon]], [[Spice Berry]], [[Strawberry]], [[Sweet Pea]] ==='''Dislike'''=== "This?... I suppose I'll cast it into the flames and see what happens." All [[Egg]]s (Except [[Void Egg]]s), All [[Milk]], [[Bone Flute]], [[Clay]], [[Cockle]], [[Crayfish]], [[Daffodil]], [[Dandelion]], [[Dried Starfish]], Dwarf Scroll, [[Dwarvish Helm]], [[Herring]], [[Holly]], [[Joja Cola]], [[Morel]], [[Nautilus Shell]], [[Sap]], [[Skeletal Hand]], [[Slime]], [[Spring Onion]], [[Stone]], [[Strange Bun]], [[Wild Horseradish]] === '''Hate''' === "Ugh, these are utterly mundane. Please refrain from bothering me with this in the future." [[Bat Wing]], [[Carp]], [[Chanterelle]], [[Chub]], [[Copper Bar]], [[Green Algae]], [[Morel]], [[Oak Resin]], [[Omni Geode]], [[Pine Tar]], [[Poppy]], [[Pufferfish]], [[Red Mushroom]], [[Refined Quartz]], [[Salmonberry]], [[Sea Urchin]], [[Snow Yam]], [[Wild Plum]] ==Dialogue== "I have seen many things about your future, Name Here." "If I were to tell you, it could have dire consequences." "I sometimes observe the local villagers in secret." "I am hoping to find an apprentice. Some day I will leave this mortal plane, but my arcane pursuits must continue." === Festivals === '''Luau''' *"The merpeople are curious about your festivities. They become upset when you litter into the ocean." '''Dance of the Moonlight Jellies''' *"How did you find me back here? I thought I was well-hidden.Perhaps you are blessed with the gift of clairvoyance." *I'm here to observe the Lunaloos...or Moonlight Jellies as you call them. They possess an unusually potent magical aura for an aquatic lifeform. '''Stardew Valley Fair''' * Welwick and I have known each other for a long time... she is a remarkable diviner, and a good friend. * That clown.. I know him from somewhere. * Was it the School of Illusion? Or maybe the Carnival of Secrets? Hmm... == Friendship == Once four hearts are reached with the Wizard the room in the back of [[Wizard's Tower|the tower]] is unlocked. It has [[The Shrine of Illusions]]. An offering of 500g to this shrine allows the player to change their appearance. ==Quest Events== '''Slay Monsters (2 Days)''' Reward: ''260 gold'' This quest can be started from the bulletin board outside of Pierre's. The Wizard will say that the "elemental balance" is out of alignment and is interfering with his magic. The quest requires the player to slay 5 to 10 [[slimes]] in [[The Mines|the mines]]. '''XXX Essence [Unlimited Time]''' Reward: ''1000 gold'' [Explanation paragraph here] This quest is started randomly upon receiving a letter and accepting the quest. The Wizard will say that he is doing magical research, and tasks you with retrieving either a solar essence or a void essence from the mines. '''Master Staff [Iridium Ingot]''' Reward: [5000 gold] 2nd year in, the wizard will request an iridium ingot for crafting a master staff. == Portraits ==

When you decide you want to become a Joja Member, I'll be delighted to help make your transition a joyous experience." |villager = yes |location = Pelican Town |address = JojaMart |work = Store Manager }} {{tocright}} '''Morris''' is a non-marriage [[villager]] found at the [[JojaMart]] store, located in the northeast region of [[Pelican Town]] in [[Stardew Valley (location)|Stardew Valley]]. Morris is the manager of [[JojaMart]] and the customer associate of [[Joja Corporation]], and contributes to most conflict that transpires later in the game. A cutscene in [[Pierre's General Store]] shows Morris coming in with coupons to lure Pierre's customers away. If the player chooses to purchase a JojaMart membership for {{Price|5000}}, the [[Community Center]] and it's restoration quests will all be replaced by the [[Joja Warehouse]], and all [[bundles]] will be replaced with cash purchases. Upon purchasing all improvements, a cutscene will ensue with Morris and a team of JojaMart employees gifting the player a [[Soda Machine]]. == Daily Routine == Morris stays inside JojaMart all day, except for unique cutscenes involving Pierre's General Store and the Community Center's restoration. == Quests ==

Archaeology Office |- ! | |} == Embarrassing Lewis == === Lucky Purple Shorts === To get [[Lucky Purple Shorts]], accept the [[Mayor's Shorts]] quest to find the Mayor's shorts on the floor of Marnie's bedroom. ''A previous solution was to put a [[Staircase]] in the player's pants slot, which would be replaced by [[Trimmed Lucky Purple Shorts]]. However, this glitch was fixed in a later update.'' Put the [[Lucky Purple Shorts]] in the Luau Soup for a very funny reaction out of the [[Governor]] and [[Lewis]]. The [[Governor]] tries the soup and says "Hmm... It's a bit tangy but actually, the flavor is quite good!" Then a question mark appears and the [[Governor]] says "Just one minute... there's something in my bowl... what's this?" The [[Governor]] then takes out [[Lucky Purple Shorts]]. [[Lewis]] then yells Whaaaat?! and [[Marnie]] gasps. The [[Governor]] then says "This... This is outrageous! I've never been so insulted in all my life!" He than throws the pants and says "Blech... my tongue is swelling up... I think I'm going to be sick." The screen fades to back for a few seconds and then the [[Governor]] is no longer there when the screen un-fades. [[Lewis]] says "Whoever took part in this appalling act is truly reprehensible. Using my very private item for this sick purpose! And to ruin a perfectly good soup... unforgivable! I've never been more ashamed of this community... Truly disgusting. Go home, the festival is over." The screen fades to black and a little box pops up saying : I guess the 'little prank' didn't go over too well... === Solid Gold Lewis Statue === ==Family== Lewis is having a secret relationship with [[Marnie]]. ==Gifts== === '''Love''' === ''"Wow, this is my favorite! Thank you!!"'' [[Hot Pepper]], [[Rabbit's Foot]], [[Vegetable Medley]] ==='''Like'''=== ''"Thanks, this is great!"'' Your response during the event will affect Lewis's affection for you. * "Yes... but I'll keep it a secret." +50 friendship points. * "Yes... and I'm going to tell everyone." -100 friendship points. '''Seven Hearts''' After gaining 7 hearts with Lewis you will receive a recipe in the mail. ==Dialogue== === Regular === *"If you plant a certain kind of flower near your beehouse, it will produce a different honey type." *"Hi there, (Name). Taking a break?" *"I hope the river doesn't overflow..." *"Good evening, (Name)! I'm glad to see you relaxing at the saloon. It's good for you to take a break now and then. Your grandfather always worked himself too hard... I'll have an extra beer in his honor tonight." *"Hi there, (Name)! How're you doing today? If you see Marnie, tell her I said 'hi'." *"Gardening is a hobby of mine, so I'm excited for this warm weather." === Festivals === '''Luau''' *"Look sharp! The governor's here for his annual visit. If you brought potluck make sure and add it to the soup cauldron." *"Should we move forward with the Luau? The governor seems a little hungry." *"Well folks, it's time once again for the potluck ceremony. I trust that you all put in high-quality ingredients in the pot this year. We don't want the governor to regret his visit to the valley. Well, governor? Would you do us the honor of tasting the soup." *"Mmm...tasty. You all did very well today. Now...who else wants some soup?" '''Dance of the Moonlight Jellies''' *"Good evening, (Name). The Moonlight Jellies are close...I already saw one glowing in the distance. Once we launch the candle-boat they'll come up to the docks and say hello." *"What do you think... should I launch the candle-boat now?" **Yes **No '''Festival of Ice''' *"Welcome to the Festival of Ice! The highlight of today's festival is the ice fishing competition. We set up this 'frozen lake' and stocked it full of fish. Just let me know when you're ready to compete." *"Are you ready to participate in the ice fishing competition?" == Quest == '''Mayor's "Shorts" ''' After gaining two hearts with [[Marnie]], you can enter her room. On the floor will be what looks like purple shorts. Pick it up and then return it to Mayor Lewis. 750g reward. '''Truffle Oil''' Lewis wants truffle oil. He won't explain what it's for. Maybe it's none of your business. 500g Reward. Appears in your mail box. == Portraits ==

He loves his solitary life though still longs to participate in town events. Sadly, he claims the belief that he would not be welcomed by the others in town. If the player passes out in [[The Mines]], Linus is one of several villagers that may carry them away to their [[farm]]. '''Egg Festival''' *"No one really talks to me...I just come for the deviled eggs." '''Luau''' *"A slow, continuous rotation is key to achieving the perfect roast." Neither of them is reachable during the event. '''Festival of Ice''' *"Igloo-building's an art I picked up from the tundra dwellers who live beyond the frozen sea. That was many years ago. An igloo makes a nice home, but it's easier to just stay in my tent year-round." ==Events== '''2 Hearts''' ''(This event may trigger regardless of your friendship with '''Linus'''. It is unknown whether this is intentional or a bug.)'' If the player visits the town at night, they may witness '''Linus''' looking through [[George]], [[Evelyn]], and [[Alex]]'s [[trash]] can. [[George]] hears the rustling from the trash can and walks outside, asking the player to scare off the "raccoons" digging through his [[Trash|garbage]]. The player continues to the [[trash]] can and sees '''Linus''' hiding beside the house. He apologizes to the player and explains that he doesn't want to let perfectly good food go to waste. '''Linus''' then asks if the player thinks what he's doing is OK. Possible responses: *''"Yes, it's disgusting."'' *''"No, it's a shame to waste perfectly good food."'' - With this answer, '''Linus''' is pleased that the player understands him and happily gives them a message for [[George]], "The raccoons are gone for good." *''"You should stop mooching off others and get a job."'' - '''Linus''' explains that not everyone is cut out for that kind of lifestyle, then dejectedly tells the player that they can tell [[George]], "The raccoons are gone for good." Once the player leaves, and '''Linus''' goes to rummage through a different trashcan. Once the player leaves, '''Linus''' starts to go through the [[Stardrop Saloon]]'s trashcan, only to be caught by [[Gus]]. Gus says, "You don't have to hide, '''Linus''', I know what you're doing there. If you need food, just ask. I can't stand for anyone in Pelican Town to go hungry! Here! I made you a basket of zucchini fritters... just make sure you dip them in my special spicy marinara sauce!" '''[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8Zd0IOwvfsI&feature=youtu.be Cutscene video]''' '''3 Hearts''' After gaining 3 hearts with '''Linus''' you will receive the following notice and recipe in the mail: [[File:Linus_3_hearts.png|thumb|left|400px]] '''4 Hearts'''[[File:Linuscutscene.png|thumb|228px]] Go into the northern woods at night to trigger this cut scene. In it, '''Linus''' invites the player to stand by the fire pit. He apologizes for mistrusting the player at first and comments on how they are uncommonly nice to him. He invites the player inside his tent to see a special kind of fish bait that he makes. He then gives them the recipe for "[[Wild Bait]]," and the cut scene ends. (Comment: I got this cutscene with 3 hearts so it may a possible bug) '''[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=j5R-RpKx2Ew&feature=youtu.be Cutscene video]''' '''8 Hearts''' Exit the [[Carpenter's Shop]] on an autumn day. Linus is foraging for berries in the nearby bushes, and is walking up to leave the mountain when [[Robin]] and the player exit the building. Robin is startled, but then offers Linus some food, which he declines. Robin points out that the player looks like they have something to say. Possible responses: * ''"I'm just pleased Linus is doing well..."'' - Linus will be relieved that the player didn't invite him to live on the farm with them, and thanks them for being his closest friend and never trying to "fix" him. * ''"I'd like to invite Linus to live on the farm with me."'' - Robin will offer to build a home on the player's property, but Linus politely declines, albeit a little hurt since he says he chooses to live the way he does. He then tells the player he appreciates their friendship, but they shouldn't try to "help" him. Afterward, Linus will leave, commenting on the "sweet aroma of berries" in the forest air. == Quests == *One quest involves '''Linus''' asking for someone to fish him up some [[Green Algae]]. *It's [[blackberry]] season (Fall), and '''Linus''' needs help finding his basket. It can be found upon following the bus road to the left--near the tunnel. ''[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=O_UlwP_7okY&feature=youtu.be Blackberry Basket Quest Video.]'' *One quest involves '''Linus''' asking for a [[Herring]]. *Another quest involves '''Linus''' asking for a [[Quartz]] *'''Community Cleanup''' on the '''Special Orders Board''' requires for you to collect 20 pieces of trash through fishing or crab pots, and put them in the trash bin in the railroad. == Portraits ==

{{Item|Sashimi}} }} {{tocright}} '''Emily''' is a [[Villager]] and one of the twelve [[Marriage Candidates]] who lives in the [[Pelican Town]] region of [[Stardew Valley (location)|Stardew Valley]]. She works part-time in [[The Stardrop Saloon]] for [[Gus]]. She will often talk about various forms and varieties of style and fashion. This would indicate that she worries a bit more about her appearance than one would otherwise perceive. Or, perhaps, she simply likes fashion, although not quite as focused on it as her sister, Haley. She's an aspiring tailor, and tells the player that she makes her own clothes. ==Daily Routine== ===Regular Schedule=== 09:00 AM : Wakes up for the day, spends time in bedroom. 12.00 PM : Emily gets out of her room. 03:30 PM : Leaves home to walk to the saloon to work. 04:00 pm : Enters Saloon. 12:30 AM : Leaves the saloon to head home for the night. ===Raining=== 09:00 AM : Wakes up for the day, spends time in her bedroom. 12:00 PM : Moves around her house. 03:30 PM : Leaves home to walk to the saloon to work. 12:30 AM : Leaves the saloon to head home for the night. ===Tuesday:=== 09:00 AM : Wakes up for the day. 11:00 AM : Leaves her house to meet Marnie, Caroline, Jodi, and Robin at Caroline's house starting at noon for exercise activities. 01:00 PM : Actual exercise begins. 04:00 PM : Stop exercise class, walks over to the saloon to work. 12:30 AM : Leaves the saloon to head home for the night. ===Saturday:=== 11:00 AM: Stays in her room. 12:00 PM : Leaves room and stay in living room ===Friday=== (after restoring the Community Center) 09:00 AM : Wakes up for the day, spends time in bedroom. 10:00 AM : Visits the community center. 03:30 PM : Goes to the saloon for work. 12:30 AM : Leaves the saloon to head home for the night. ==Family== {| border="0" cellpadding="1" cellspacing="1" class="article-table article-table-selected" style="height: 50px; width: 400px;" ! scope="row"|[[File:Haley.png|thumb|left|100px]] | '''[[Haley]]''' '''(Sister)''' |} ==Gifts== ===Loved:=== "This gift is fabulous! '''Four Hearts''' When you enter Pelican Town you will be rewarded with a cutscene, where Emily leaves her house and spots a pack of unique birds. One of them crashes at her window, she picks him up and mends his injuries. ==='''Six Hearts'''=== [[File:Emily_dance.png|300px|right]] At six hearts, when visiting her house you'll enter a cutscene where she turns on a stereo and dances. Your response will affect her affection for you. "That was amazing!" +25 friendship points. "That was embarrassing..." -50 friendship points. "(Say nothing and do a slow clap)" +25 friendship points. Cutscene video: https://youtu.be/XWaSEwN4gBw '''Eight Hearts''' After reaching eight hearts, in the next morning you will receive mail from Emily telling you to come to [[Lewis|Mayor Lewis]]' house for the clothing therapy. When entering, Emily is already explaining this therapy. At the end Emily tries to tell you something, but [[Clint]] roughly interrupts her. '''Ten Hearts''' When you get a ten hearts relationship with Emily, you will receive a letter in the next morning. She invites you for a camping in the secret woods. You must enter after 10PM while not raining and you before must remove the giant log out of the way, which requires a steel axe. The cutscene is lovely but getting better when a bear make an appearance. You both run into the tent, Emily leaves her sleeping bag outside and "sadly" you will have to share yours with her. '''Sewing Machine''' In Haley and Emily’s home there is a Sewing Machine. You aren’t able to use it until you get cloth. If you do, Emily will visit your house and you will learn how to use the Sewing Machine. ==Dialogue== *"This house was left in our care by my parents. They've been traveling the world for the last two years." *"We have no idea when they'll be back." *"I enjoy living here, though. It's a beautiful area and the town is nice." *"It never rains in the Calico Desert... That's where my friend Sandy lives." *"I wish I could've visited her today." *"Do you know how to cook "Bean Hotpot"? I like that dish quite a bit. It's hard to get fresh ingredients in the winter, huh?" *"Hi!...Yes?" *"I bet you're an excellent farmer by now!" *"Haley and I aren't made for such a big house. It's a hassle to keep it clean. Ah, well. I really shouldn't be complaining. Your farmhouse seems nice and cozy." *"I consider the bees and butterflies as my special friends!" *"Haley is a picky eater. It's so hard to cook for her." *'''Exercising at Pierre's''' - "Exercising can be fun!" ===Festivals=== '''Egg Festival''' *"I've been up since dawn coloring eggs...it's always my favorite part of the season." '''Dance of the Moonlight Jellies''' *"Look out there, at the endless sea. Deep underwater, all kinds of life forms are moving around in the dark. Eerie, isn't it?" '''Festival of Ice''' *"Wow, this snowman needs a makeover. Who made this?" == Portraits ==

'''Festival of Ice''' *"Did I ever tell you how George and I first met? He actually pelted me with a snowball in this very festival. He was a gentleman back then, and came over to see if I was okay." == Heart Events == '''Three Hearts''' After gaining 3 hearts with Evelyn, you will receive a recipe in the mail. '''Four Hearts: '''Cutscene starts upon entering Evelyn's house. She is baking cookies and offers Player to try some, then asks for opinion: # "It's delicious!" +100 friendship points, cookie recipe. # "It was like chewing on a hockey puck." -100 friendship points. Cutscene video: https://youtu.be/yXYi-dM4WEI '''Seven Hearts''' After gaining 7 hearts with Evelyn, she will send you a recipe in the mail. == Portraits ==

{{Item|Quartz}} }} {{tocright}} '''Alex''' is a [[Villager]] and one of the twelve [[Marriage Candidates]] who lives in the [[Pelican Town]] region of [[Stardew Valley (location)|Stardew Valley]]. Alex loves sports, specifically "gridball", and hanging out at the [[beach]]. He can be arrogant at times, bragging to everyone that he is going to be a professional athlete. He believes studying is for "nerds". Alex often works out in the men’s locker room or in his room, and he works at the ice cream stand in the summer. When the player becomes friends with him, he seems to warm up them and stops bragging as much. He admits to the player that he loves his grandmother so much, but jokes that he doesn't love his grandfather as much. He is good friends with [[Haley]]. ==Family:== {| class="article-table" style="width: 400px;" border="0" cellpadding="1" cellspacing="1" |- ! scope="col" |[[File:George.png|left]] ! scope="col" | [[George]] (Grandfather) |} {| class="article-table" style="width: 400px;" border="0" cellpadding="1" cellspacing="1" |- ! scope="col" |[[File:Evelyn.png|left]] ! scope="col" | [[Evelyn]] (Grandmother) |} ==Gifts== ==='''Loves'''=== "Awesome! I love this stuff." [[Complete Breakfast]], [[Prismatic Shard]], [[Rabbit's Foot]], [[Golden Pumpkin]], [[Salmon Dinner]], Jack be Nimble Jack be Thick (available at book seller) ==='''Like'''=== "This is cool! Thanks." All [[cooking]] (except [[Fried Egg]] or [[Bread]]), All [[Mayonnaise]], [[Amethyst]], [[Apple]], [[Apricot]], [[Artichoke]], [[Aquamarine]], [[Beer]], [[Blackberry Cobbler]], [[Wine|Blackberry Wine]], [[Blue Jazz]], [[Cauliflower]], [[Cheese]], [[Trees|Cherry]], [[Chocolate Cake]], [[Chowder]], [[Cloth]], [[Coffee]], [[Cookies]], [[Corn]], [[Cranberry Sauce]], [[Diamond]], [[Earth Crystal]], [[Eggplant]], [[Eggplant Parmesan]], [[Egg|Eggs]] (All except Void and thunder), [[Emerald]], [[Frozen Tear]], [[Green Bean]], [[Ice Cream]], [[Jade]], [[Jelly]] ([[Blackberry]], [[Blueberry]], [[Cherry]], [[Grape]]), [[Kale]], [[Miner's Treat]], [[Omelet]], [[Artisan Goods|Pale Ale]], [[Parsnip]], [[Pickle|Pickled]] ([[Artichoke]], [[Corn]], [[Green Bean]], [[Hops]], [[Parsnip]], [[Tomato]]), [[Pizza]], [[Potato]], [[Radish]], [[Red Plate]], [[Ruby]], [[Salad]], [[Salmon Dinner]], [[Sashimi]], [[Spaghetti]], [[Sunflower]], [[Sweet Pea]], [[Summer Spangle]], [[Tomato]], [[Trout Soup]], [[Tulip]], [[Wild Honey]], [[Wine]] ([[Hot Pepper]], no[[Strawberry]]), [[Rhubarb Pie]] ==='''Neutral'''=== "Thanks!" This is garbage." [[Bat Wing]], [[Carp]], [[Copper Ore]], [[Grape]], [[Holly]], [[Joja Cola]], Plasma TV, [[Poppy]], [[Prehistoric Skull]], [[Quartz]], [[Rusty Cog]], [[Rusty Spoon]], [[Rusty Spur]], [[Sap]], [[Stone]], [[Muscle Remedy]], [[Grass Starter]], [[Green Algae]] ==Heart Events== ===Triggering===
'''Two Hearts:''' Go to the [[beach]] while Alex is there (summer is the only season where Alex visits the beach). (see schedule below) '''Four''' '''Hearts:''' Walk into town after 9 AM. '''Five Hearts:''' Walk into Alex's house while he is inside. '''Six Hearts:''' Go into Alex's house when he's usually working out. '''Eight Hearts:''' Go to the [[beach]] in the summer on a sunny day. '''Ten Hearts:''' Go to the Saloon at night. (He will send a letter in the mail to do so.) '''Marriage'''
===Details=== '''*WARNING: THE FOLLOWING SECTION CONTAINS MAJOR SPOILERS FOR ALEX'S HEART EVENTS*'''
'''Two Hearts''' [[File:Alexheart1.png|thumb|286px]] Alex greets the player and comments that he's enjoying the great weather they're having. He'll throw his football to the player, which they miserably fail to catch. He laughs and tells them that it was a "nice try". He goes on to tell the player he's sure that he's going to become the first pro grid ballplayer from Stardew Valley. The player can then choose between two responses: *"I believe in you!" : Alex thanks the player for their support and says that he'll remember it. *"Wow, you're really arrogant." : Alex gets angry and says the player is just jealous, then he leaves. '''Cutscene video: '''https://youtu.be/Boe6ITC-8t8 '''Four Hearts'''[[File:Alextwohearts.png|thumb|298px]] Alex is next to the dog pen near his home. He's talking to the dog, whose name is revealed as Dusty. He comments both he and the dog have been through a lot and that he feels misunderstood. The player's character will come out from behind the Saloon. Alex asks if they heard any of that. The player then has two options: *"Yes, I heard everything." *"Not really...why?" Both responses lead to him revealing more about what he was talking about. He tells the player that the reason he lives with his grandparents is because of his dad. His dad was a drunk and would often say abusive things to Alex. One day his dad left, and shortly after his mother got sick and died. Alex then goes on to say that he shouldn't dwell on it and doesn't need sympathy. At the end of the cutscene, he gives Dusty a steak. '''Cutscene video:''' https://youtu.be/KgyD6K__BW4 '''Five hearts'''

Alex will be standing in front of his bookcase thinking about how he's never opened one of the books. He then calls himself worthless. The player have three choices.

*"That's crazy. You're a genius!" no change in friendship points, Alex says "No I'm not. You just try to flatter me!" *"We all have our strengths and weaknesses." +50 friendship points, Alex says 'Yeah, I guess you are right. Well, I'm not going to give up!' and tells a joke about going to get dinner. * "Worthless? Yeah, that about sums it up." -50 friendship points, Alex says, "Thanks for telling me the truth." and reacts sadly. '''Cutscene video:''' https://youtu.be/BBn2_Nel-Gk '''Six Hearts''' Go into Alex's house when he usually works out, and a cutscene will trigger. He doubts himself, thinking he might not be good enough to be a professional Gridball player. He then apologizes for having no shirt and acting arrogant and when he and the player first met, and that he's trying to become better. There are no choices in this event. '''Cutscene video:''' https://youtu.be/OQrP00m9spA '''Eight Hearts''' During Summer on a sunny day, visit the beach between 9:00 AM and 12:00 PM to trigger the event. Alex is sitting on the beach crying. The player approaches him and sits down next to him. He says today is the day his mother died 12 years ago. He regrets not being able to say "thank you" to her for taking care of him when he was a kid. The only keepsake he has left is his mother's music box. Alex opens it and plays it for both of them. As the music plays, the player will see a vision of Alex's mother happily cradling baby Alex in her arms. As the music fades, he asks what the player is thinking. *"Honor your mother's memory by doing your best every day." Alex agrees and says that's why he's working so hard to be a professional grid ballplayer. * "You shouldn't dwell on the past." *"I'll always be here for you if you get lonely." Alex thanks the player and bashfully says you're his best friend in the whole town. * "You need to get over it. Life is tough." After calming down, he says the two of them should head back to town. Before the player leaves, he nervously asks them not to tell anyone that he was crying. The player laughs and walks off while he hurriedly chases after them. '''Cutscene video:''' https://youtu.be/alNmHkYsNbo '''Ten Hearts''' Alex asks the player on a dinner date. During the dinner (if you are male), Alex will say that he had a crush on the player ever since they moved in, but he denied his feelings for them otherwise. Alex says he thought the player was cute and says that when he has a crush the feeling goes away quickly but for them, it kept growing. The player has the option to tell him you have the same feelings, or that you don't like him in that way. *"I feel the same way." Alex is elated that both of them were finally able to admit their feelings to each other. He happily digs into his steak. Dusty suddenly bursts through the window, salivating at the smell of food. *"I'm sorry... I don't feel that way about you." Alex is crushed and apologizes for making the player uncomfortable. He loses his appetite. '''Cutscene video:''' https://youtu.be/_9fxqqsQD0M '''Marriage''' Go to the beach on a rainy day to find the mariner. Talk to the mariner and purchase the mermaid's necklace. After the player gives it to Alex, he will accept it and agree to the marriage. Marriage will occur three days later regardless of the season. ==Dialogue== ===First Meeting=== "Hey, you're the new girl/guy, huh? I think we're gonna get along great. I'm Alex." ... "I'll see you around." ===Regular=== *"What, you want to talk to me? I'm busy." * "Hey, when I turn pro you can say you were my first "fan". Not bad, huh?" * "The beach is a cool place to hang out and soak up some rays." ... "You gotta spend some time in the sun or else you'll get all pale." ... "Hey, do you wanna hang out with me at the beach sometime? Do you have a bikini?" * "There are some weird people living in this town...like that guy [[Sebastian]]. Is he a 'goth' or something? I don't understand it." *"People stay indoors a lot during the winter and do boring stuff. Maybe if I read a book, I'd be less bored...Nah." *"Hey, nice tan." ===After Marriage=== *"Wow, you look beautiful today." *"Did you get a haircut or something? You're looking pretty good today. Maybe it's all that fresh air..." *"Hey, honey! I made you a hot breakfast!" (he gifts the player a breakfast dish) "If you want to get strong, you have to eat as you mean it!" *"Tell me all about your day. It's good to get everything off your chest now and then." * "If you need some quiet time to yourself, that's okay with me." *"Sometimes I wonder if I'm doing the right thing with my life..." * "I'm going into town today. I'll see you tonight." (Mondays) *"I had a good day. I like to see my grandparents often, they're getting pretty old." (Mondays) ===Questions=== "What do you think about my haircut?" *It looks very fashionable - "Yeah, I know. That's why I have it like this." *It looks like some kind of fungal growth - "Yeah, right. You're just jealous that I look so good." "Hey, do you wanna toss the ball around with me?" *If you choose "Yeah I'll play with you", you get "It looks like I underestimated you but my arm's sore so maybe another time." "Hey Farmgirl, I've got a question for you. Do you think I'll ever turn pro?" * If the player chooses "Maybe if you practice a lot", Alex says "Yeah, well I'm so good I'm not going to have to practice all that much." * If the player chooses "Yes, you'll be sports legend", Alex says "Hey, Now that's what I'm talking about!" *If the player chooses "No, you'll most likely fail and become a salesman", Alex says "That's ridiculous. You're just jealous that I'm way more popular than you'll ever be, freak." "If you weren't a girl I'd ask you to play catch." *I'm fine just watching you from a distance. - "Yeah, some people just aren't made for sports." *I want to play catch with you! - "Really? I guess I underestimated you. My arm's a little sore, but maybe next time." * (angry) What's that supposed to mean? - "Uh...Nevermind." ===Festivals=== '''Egg Festival''' * "I try to eat at least three eggs every day. I need that protein for my legs." '''Luau''' *"Perfect weather for a beach party, huh?" '''Dance of the Moonlight Jellies''' *"I can't believe summer's over...I feel like it just started." '''Festival of Ice''' *"Snowmen are okay, I guess. But mostly I'm looking forward to spring." ==Trivia== *Alex was originally called Josh during the game's early development. == Portraits ==

{{Item|Super Cucumber}} }} {{tocright}} '''Elliott''' is a [[Villager]] and one of the twelve [[Marriage Candidates]] who lives in [[The Beach]] region of [[Stardew Valley (location)|Stardew Valley]]. Elliott lives alone in his [[Elliott's Cabin|cabin]] on [[The Beach]]. He is a writer who dreams of one day writing a magnificent novel. He is a sentimental "romantic" with a tendency to go off onto flowery, poetic tangents. When he can afford it, he enjoys a strong pito at the [[Saloon]]. ==Gifts== ==='''Loved:'''=== "(Name), this is a beautiful gift! Thank you!" He'll show the player his writing desk, where he spends most of his time, and he'll tell them about how no one believes he can make it as a writer. He will ask them about your favorite kind of books. The player's answer will inspire him to pursue that genre. Each of the three answers are worth 30 friendship points. * "Mystery." -- "Mystery, huh? It's definitely an exciting genre. I'll remember that." He then says you must know a lot about plants, and asks you to look at the rose on his desk. * "Romance." -- "Ah, one of the classic genres. I'll remember that." He states, before supplying that as a farmer you must know a lot about plants. He asks you to inspect the rose on his desk to see if it's healthy. * "Scifi." -- He seems pleasantly surprised, and he supposes even people in "earthy" professions must have their heads in the clouds. He then says you must know a lot about plants, and asks you to look at the rose on his desk. '''Cutscene video: '''https://youtu.be/TtrobQ8zIlY '''Four Hearts''' Saloon, 3pm - 10pm, any weather Enter the saloon. Elliott will come in and order a drink for himself and for the player. He will then propose a toast, and ask you what they should toast to: *"To Pelican Town!" +25 friendship points. "Ah, to a harmonious future for the community... what a virtuous idea. Here's to Pelican Town!" *"To our friendship!" +50 friendship points. "That's a great idea! Here's to us!" *"To my good health!" -10 friendship points "Well... okay." *"To your doom!" -50 friendship points. "Hmph. Forget it." The two both get drunk. Elliott does a drunk dance, and the player laughs. '''Cutscene video:''' [https://youtu.be/ZAT1Co_dRfw https://youtu.be/f6g6BP7djLk] '''Six Hearts''' Enter his cabin during the day (near 10am). Elliott is playing piano. *'''That was wonderful.''' -- Elliott says thank you, but he's not very good at it. It's the only pleasure he allows himself! *'''How long have you been playing?''' -- "Oh, I'm not sure... I've been dabbling in piano since I was a kid. I'm not very good, but it's fun." Elliott talks about his dwindling bank account. He envies the player. He wishes he could throw everything away and be a farmer like them. *'''Being a farmer is just as hard, you know.''' -- Elliott is embarrassed! He didn't mean to say something so insensitive. *'''Come live on the farm. I could use the extra help.''' -- Elliot is surprised! "It sounds wonderful... but I can't give up on my novel. It's already half-way done." '''Cutscene video:''' [https://youtu.be/bS_I6ZEqrFw https://youtu.be/jb9x3oD1NP4] '''Eight Hearts''' The player will receive an invitation to a public book reading by mail the next day. The reading takes place in the afternoon of the same day in the library. '''Cutscene video:''' [https://youtu.be/CCw0K7sFQAg https://youtu.be/OM0OXl4D50M] '''Ten Hearts''' Beach, 8am - 1pm, sunny weather The next morning the player will receive a letter in the mail from Elliott asking you to meet him on the docks on a sunny morning. They will go on a boat trip together, he has struggles to say that he loves the farmer. When he kissed them, he asks why they are trembling. The player can choose: *"I am happy." +50 friendship points. Elliott agrees with the player. *"You're making me very uncomfortable. Stop." -50 friendship points. '''Cutscene video: '''https://youtu.be/1KCRgOCJvIU '''Marriage''' When you ask Elliott to marry you and he accepts, the marriage will take place in the town square 3 days later. '''Married Life''' *Occasionally waters all the crops or feeds all the animals and fills up your pets water bowl or repairs the fences. **Often makes breakfast for you, like pancakes, omelet, coffee, and bread. *Spends his time in the kitchen where he often makes breakfast for you, then wandering around the house, most days he likes to spend time in his study nook "writing", some mornings he isn't in the house but outside where he has completed a farm task in consideration for you. *Has his own area extending off the bedroom, as he is a writer it can be likened to a study nook with wooden floor and a Victorian/Edwardian style library. *Once finished chatting you can click again to kiss, the first kiss of each day results in a little heart. *At events is in the same places as usual but acts as your husband by saying things such as at the Dance of the Moonlight Jellies when you talk to him he will say "Don't worry dear, I won't talk to any girls, have a good time and relax." *Uses affectionate nicknames to address you such as "dear" "honey", "darling". *Most conversations involve him expressing concern for you working so hard, saying how much he appreciates you, or saying very loving writer-esque phrases or poems about you, for example telling you to stay out of the rain so you don't catch a cold, etc. *His cabin on the beach is still open and remains unchanged however he doesn't use it anymore. ''Phrases'' "I made a whole secret book of poems expressing my love for you." "I spent the morning repairing a few of the fences.. They should be as good as new." "Fertile soil beneath my feet, fresh air to fill my lungs, and the sun's warmth to delight my skin...Life is going well." "If I stay perfectly still, perhaps a resplendent butterfly will bless my nose with a landing." "I think I'll walk down to the beach today, it's always nice to see the ocean again." "Today is going to be a fantastic day... I can feel it!" "I get this special feeling in my nose..." "I think I might do some writing today." "Will you be okay without my help?" "Your feminine (masculine for same-sex couples) allure is irresistible today. I can't keep my eyes off you." "Would you still love me if I guzzled two gallons of pumpkin ale at the spirits eve festival? Sometimes a man has primitive urges." "No matter how much I clean the house keeps getting dirty again. I guess farms can be kind of dirty." "I've had this reoccurring nightmare that you gave me a buzz cut... you wouldn't ever do that to me, would you?" "I had a nice time at the beach by myself, I watched the waves come and go, just like old times." "I drank too much coffee... my mouth feels about as dry as the calico desert. Oh... sorry about the coffee breath." "I've been taking much better care of myself now that we're together. The bachelor life wasn't particularly healthy for me." "I'm a little out of practice but I plan on entering the fishing contest tomorrow! You’ve got some stiff competition, dear." "Wow, you look really handsome today! Did you shave? Your jawline is perfect." "You always smell so good after a hard day of work. It's your natural musk! You smell sweet, my dear. Like a honeycomb drifting on a pool of spice tea." "From the brightest winter star, to the shimmer of an iridium vein... nothing can compare to my wonderful woman (man for same-sex couples)." "My skill with words is unmatched, yet I can't find the way to properly describe your allure." "Come here, let me massage your back. You look tense." ==Daily Routine== ==='''Spring'''===

==Dialogue== ===First Meeting=== "Ah, the new farmer we’ve all been expecting…and whose arrival has sparked many a conversation! I’m Elliott...I live in the little cabin by the beach. It’s a pleasure to meet you.” ===Regular=== "I woke up this morning to a little sunbeam on my face. It was delightful." "The forest is a wonderful place. Have you been there?" "Oh no! My shoes are filled with sand. That's the trouble of living on the beach." ===Questions=== ??? ===Festivals=== '''Egg Festival''' *"Taking breaks from work can make you more productive in the long run." '''Luau''' *"I woke up late, stepped out the door, and found myself in the middle of all this hubbub! I forgot that today was the Luau." '''Dance of the Moonlight Jellies''' *"If we keep polluting the ocean, the jellies will surely go extinct. It's already in the process of happening." *"What a shame...we have no respect for nature anymore." '''Ice Festival''' *"I'm entering the ice fishing competition today. Why not? It's rare that [[Willy]] ever loses, though." == Portraits ==

I'd lose my job." |villager = yes |location = Witch's Swamp |address = Witch's Hut |friends = [[File:Witch Icon.png|20px|link=]] [[Witch]] |work = Guard }} The '''Henchman''' is a non-marriage [[Villager]] only found at the [[Witch's Swamp]], blocking the path to the [[Witch's Hut]]. The player can reach this area after they are tasked by the [[Wizard]] to retrieve his [[Magic Ink]] from his ex-wife, the [[Witch]]. The Henchman is barring the path forward and must be brought [[Void Mayonnaise]] to entice him to leave. After he disappears, he cannot be seen in the game again, and the path to the Witch's Hut permanently stays open. == Quests == Discovering how to get past the Henchman is the objective of the [[Goblin Problem]] quest. A [[Lost Book]], which can be read at the library after being found, reveals that Goblins love Void Mayonnaise. The expanded questline to access the Witch's Hut involves two other quests, which become available after completing all the [[Community Center]] or [[Joja Warehouse]] tasks and [[Bundles]]. {| class="wikitable" !Quest Name !Quest Text !Provided By !Requirements !Rewards |- |Goblin Problem |There's a goblin blocking the path to the Witch's hut. There must be some way to get him to move... {{Item|Holly}} }} {{tocright}} '''Abigail''' is a [[villager]] and a [[marriage candidate]], who lives at [[Pierre's General Store]] with her parents, [[Caroline]] and [[Pierre]]. She sometimes fights with her mother, who worries about Abigail's "alternative lifestyle". Abigail enjoys playing the flute, exploring, has a knack for adventure, and often talks to the player about her dreams of one day becoming a farmer. Being good friends with [[Sebastian]] and [[Sam]], she can often be found hanging out with them at the [[Stardrop Saloon|Saloon]] and at [[festivals]]. {|class="article-table" style="margin:0 auto 1em 0;border:9px double #898989;background-color:inherit;font-size:16px;text-align:center" !style="font-size:18px;border-bottom:3px solid #898989;text-align:center"|Mother !style="font-size:18px;border-bottom:3px solid #898989;text-align:center;border-right:9px double #898989"|Father !style="font-size:18px;border-bottom:3px solid #898989;text-align:center" colspan="2"|Friends |- |[[File:Caroline.png|80px|link=Caroline]] |style="border-right:9px double #898989"|[[File:Pierre.png|80px|link=Pierre]] |[[File:Sam.png|center|80px|link=Sam]] |[[File:Sebastian.png|center|80px|link=Sebastian]] |- |[[Caroline]] |style="border-right:9px double #898989"|[[Pierre]] |[[Sam]] |[[Sebastian]] |} == Friendship Events == Abigail has 5 [[friendship]] events with cutscenes, some with dialogue choices the player may choose that can give or take friendship points. ---- '''2 Hearts'''  [[File:Heart Icon 02.png|link=]]
Upon entering Pierre's, the player will find Abigail trying to beat the first level of [[Journey of the Prairie King]]. She asks the player to help and play together. To win, the player needs to survive until the timer ends. ---- '''4 Hearts'''  [[File:Heart Icon 04.png|link=]]
Enter the mountains between 12pm and 7pm on a rainy day. The player will find Abigail playing her flute under a tree, or stump (depending on whether the player has chopped it down before the cutscene). She will then ask the player what they are doing. * '''Just doing some work.''' (0 pts) * '''Enjoying the weather.''' (+ 50 pts) * '''I could ask you the same question.''' (0 pts) After selecting a dialogue option, the player then pulls out a mini-harp and plays along with Abigail. ---- '''6 Hearts'''  [[File:Heart Icon 06.png|link=]]
Enter town after 9pm. The player will find Abigail sitting in the graveyard. She tells the player that she's practicing her swordsmanship and asks the player if they have ever used a sword before. * '''Yes, and it's exciting.''' (+ 10 pts) * '''Yes, but only in self-defense.''' (+ 10 pts) * '''Yes, but it's dangerous. You should stay safe.''' (- 100 pts) * '''No.''' (0 pts) ---- '''8 Hearts'''  [[File:Heart Icon 08.png|link=]]
After getting a letter from Abigail, enter the shop between 8:00-10:00pm. There are no dialogue options with the cutscene. She shows the player her spirit board and it stars moving it says I [[File:Heart Icon 01.png|20px|link=]] (first letter of the player's name). She then realizes and "accidentally" breaks the board. ---- '''10 Hearts'''  [[File:Heart Icon 10.png|link=]]
After giving Abigail a [[Bouquet of Flowers]] (purchased at [[Pierre's General Store]]), enter [[The Mines]] between 5pm and 12am. Abigail will enter and peer down the ladder and gets frightened by a bat. She laughs and decides to look down once again, only for a swarm of bats to come out. The player finds her in a corner and is presented with two dialogue options: * '''What happened?''' (+ 20 pts) * '''Are you OK?''' (+ 40 pts) She responds, "Maybe I'm not as tough as I thought." The player then has two more dialogue options: * '''You're safe with me.''' (+ 20 pts) * '''I get scared too.''' (+ 40 pts) Abigail then confesses her love to the player and they kiss. ---- '''14 Hearts'''  [[File:Heart Icon 14.png|link=]]
After reaching 14 hearts of friendship in their marriage, the player may enter [[The Backwoods]] between 6:10 am and 5 pm to trigger a cutscene. The player is shown foraging around in some bushes when a monster attacks. The player falls and Abigail appears, slaying the monster and saving the player from death. She asks the player if they are okay before confessing that she's never taken a life before now. The player is then presented with dialogue choices to respond. Whichever is chosen, there is no gain or loss of friendship points, but each option results in a different response from her. * '''It's sad, but there was no other option.'''
- ''"Yeah... I did what I had to do. I guess the world's a pretty tough place. It was either you or him, right?"'' * '''Monsters don't deserve our sympathy!'''
- ''"... Aren't they just trying to survive, like us? They may be our enemies, but I still think they deserve sympathy. Still... I did what had to be done."'' * '''It's a harsh world, kid.'''
- ''"Huh? That's pretty funny coming from someone who just got rescued... But... yeah... Sometimes reality forces us to do things we'd rather not... Guess I'm learning that the hard way."'' * '''Did you have to kill him?'''
- ''"Hey! I saved your life, didn't I? Maybe you should think about that instead of putting me on a guilt trip."'' Abigail tells the player, "I don't want to lose you," and cautions them to be more careful next time. She will then bury the slain monster and put a symbol of Yoba on the gravesite, which from then on reads "Abigail took a life to save mine... I'll never forget that." == Marriage == After [[marriage]], Abigail moves into the [[Farmhouse]] and her own room is added in the southeast corner of the house. It is decorated with an underwater, ocean-themed wallpaper and contains furniture like a TV and gaming console, a drum-set, a sword leaned against the wall, and a cage for her pet David Jr. resting atop a dresser (David stays in her old room at Pierre's). On days when Abigail stays at the Farm, she may be found in the fenced garden-patio area (located in the northeast corner of the Farm), playing her flute. {{Item|Void Egg}} }} {{tocright}} '''Leah''' is a [[Villager]] and one of the twelve [[Marriage Candidates]] who lives in the [[Cindersap Forest]] region of [[Stardew Valley (location)|Stardew Valley]]. Leah lives alone in her small [[Leah's Cottage|cottage]] located south of [[Marnie's Ranch]] in the Cindersap Forest. She loves to spend time outside, [[foraging]] for a wild meal, or simply enjoying the gifts of the [[season]]. She enjoys art and nature and can often be observed around the forest drawing in her book, or spending time at her home working on other artistic passions. Leah is somewhat reserved with no family or relatives living in [[Pelican Town]]. Occasionally she visits [[Stardrop Saloon]] with [[Elliott|Elliot]]. If the player chooses to progress through her story line by raising their heart level, a history of drama and a great escape to the country side is soon revealed. Leah appreciates nature, animals, and living a calm life. She often speaks to the player of how nice it must be to live on their farm, as well as several reminders of the two's neighborly housing situation. While she is not adventurous as [[Abigail]], Leah definitely enjoys exploring the woods and collecting the gifts each season bestows upon the valley. ''She's a talented artist with a large portfolio of work, yet she's too nervous to display it to the public. {{Item|Truffle}} }} {{tocright}} '''Maru''' is a [[Villager]] and one of the twelve [[Marriage Candidates]] who lives in the [[Mountain]] region of [[Stardew Valley (location)|Stardew Valley]], with her mother [[Robin]], her father [[Demetrius]], and her step-brother [[Sebastian]]. When she isn’t in her room, fiddling with tools and machinery, she sometimes does odd jobs at the local [[Harvey's Clinic]]. Friendly, outgoing, and ambitious, Maru would be quite a lucky match for a lowly newcomer such as yourself... [[Bat Wing]], [[Copper Ore]], [[Dwarf Scroll III]], [[Green Algae]], [[Holly]], [[Iron Ore]], [[Joja Cola]], [[Preserves Jar]] ([[Corn]], [[Tomato]]), [[Poppy]], [[Red Mushroom]], [[Rusty Cog]], [[Rusty Spoon]], [[Rusty Spur]], [[Sea Urchin]], [[Snail]], [[Snow Yam]], [[Stone]], [[Truffle]], [[Wild Honey]], [[Shane]], Hay ==Heart Events== '''Two Hearts''' (Known times:Saturday after 9PM, Sunday sometimes after 1PM, Wednesday after 10AM, Friday after 12PM, Monday before 12PM, other days/times are unknown) As you walk into their house, you find Maru and Demetrius in their lab. Maru asks you to watch a beaker as she has to go do something. While you're watching the beaker, Demetrius starts talking to you about his special little girl Maru. Demetrius states that he doesn't want anything getting in the way of Maru's future "If you know what I mean." When Maru returns, Demetrius tells Maru that he was telling you about the tests. "Right, [Player Name]?" * "(Say nothing)" - +10 friendship points. Both Demetrius and Maru go back to their work. * "Actually, your dad was being weird." - -100 friendship points with Demetrius. Maru will ask Demetrius what [Player Name] is talking about. Demetrius will tell the truth and apologize for his behaviour. '''Four Hearts''' Harvey's Clinic Tuesday/Thursday After 9am Maru will be working on samples (which she seems to be tired of), and as the player enters the clinic, her concentration will break, surprising her and causing her to drop a vial. She panics and asks the player what she should do. * "Just scoop it off the floor, he won't know the difference." -50 friendship points. She will argue that of course Harvey will be able to tell the difference. Harvey comes in after hearing the breaking glass, and Maru tells him it was an accident. He is thankful for her telling the truth, since she is a big help around the clinic. It ends with Harvey asking if the player is OK, since they're looking a little pale * "Tell Harvey it's my fault." -20 friendship points. She agrees and tells Harvey once he comes in from hearing glass break he is disappointed she blamed someone else and it ends with Harvey saying it'll put them back in red for a month. * "Tell Harvey it was an accident." +50 friendship points. She agrees and tells Harvey once he comes in from hearing glass break he is thankful for her telling the truth since she is a big help around the clinic, in the end Harvey asks if the player is OK, since they're looking a bit pale. '''Six Hearts''' Mountain, 9pm - 11:40pm, sunny weather Maru is looking through the telescope and is surprised to see you walking past. She offers you to look through the telescope and asks what you see. You have the option to say: "A cold, dark abyss" - -30 friendship points "A beautiful planet" - +30 friendship points. She mentions that she has something to tell you but thinks about it and changes her mind and decides to show you a binary star system instead. Your character feels as if Maru showed you something special. '''Eight Hearts''' In her House. Maru will show you what she's been working on, and accidentally electrically shock you in the process of testing it. You can respond to her apology * "It's okay, it doesn't even hurt." - +30 friendship points. * "You'd better be. This hurts like crazy!" - -50 friendship points. '''Ten Hearts''' Carpenter's Shop, 9am - 4pm, any weather You go into her house and she says that her project is finished. Now she takes you into her workshop (trapdoor) to show you a robot she built to help her parents. Demetrius follows you and gets scared by the robot Maru activated. The robot wants his freedom so they let her go. Maru will ask you what you think which may affect her affection for you. * "I'm so impressed with your inventions." - +50 friendship points. * "I'm disappointed... you should have made that robot your slave." - -50 friendship points. ** "MarILDA's just a piece of machinery designed to act human." +50 friendship points. ** "I was just kidding. MarILDA deserves her freedom." +50 friendship points. ** "I would've put her to work on the farm." -50 friendship points. * "So is your Dad okay with 'us' now?" No change in friendship points. * "(Just stare at Maru and say nothing)" No change in friendship points. Immediately after you go to sleep on the second day, a cutscene happens in which Lewis declares you two married (this cutscene uses up no time at all). You appear back Home after the marriage cutscene with Maru standing on the porch,she says she watered all the crops and put water in your pet's bowl. ==Dialogue== ===First Meeting=== “Oh! Aren’t you the one who just moved in? I’m Maru. I’ve been looking forward to meeting you!” ... “You know, with a small town like this, a new face can really alter the community dynamic. It’s exciting!” ===Regular=== "When it rains I have a good excuse to work on my gadgets all day." "It must be kind of boring for you, though." "Hey, have any interesting farm stories to tell me? Guess not." "I get so sleepy when it's cold..." "My hair gets so frizzy in this dry weather. *sigh*" ===Questions=== "I've decided I'm going to build a robot someday." *That should be very easy for you. Response: "Really? Are you sure you're not just trying to flatter me?" *You should be more realistic. Response: "You don't think I could do it?" *It sounds challenging. Response: "You're right, but I love a challenge!" ===Festivals=== '''Egg Festival''' *"I always look forward to these gatherings...it makes the valley feel like a real community." '''Luau''' *"Whatever Linus is roasting smells awfully good..." *slurp* '''Dance of the Moonlight Jellies''' *"It's kind of cold, actually. I guess fall is right around the corner." '''Festival of Ice''' *"I'm not very creative when it comes to snowmen." == Trivia == * Maru's name seems to be originated from a japanese word '''''丸 maru (circle)'''''. *Maru and [[Demetrius]] are the only brown skinned pre-made villagers currently ingame. == Portraits ==

{{Item|Spice Berry}} }} {{tocright}} '''Harvey''' is a [[Villager]] and one of the twelve [[Marriage Candidates]] who lives in the [[Pelican Town]] region of [[Stardew Valley (location)|Stardew Valley]]. Harvey is the town doctor. He's a little old for a [[bachelor]], but he has a kind heart and a respected position in the community. He lives in a small apartment above the [[Medical Clinic]], but spends most of his time working. Harvey collects plane models and proudly displays them in his room, in addition with a fully functioning broadcast radio. He seems to also be a fan of Jazz music. ==Gifts== ==='''Love'''=== ''"It's for me? This is my favorite stuff! It's like you read my mind."'' [[Bat Wing]], [[Chewing Stick]], [[Coral]], [[Glass Shards]], [[Joja Cola]], [[Nautilus Shell]], [[Poppy]], [[Rainbow Shell]], [[Salmonberry]], [[Sea Urchin]], [[Spice Berry]], [[Sugar]]. ==Heart Events== '''Two Hearts''' Enter [[Alex]] and his grandparents house to see Harvey checking up on [[George]]. Harvey tells [[George]] he'll need to make some lifestyle changes to keep healthy, but [[George]] seems irritated and says he knows what's best for his own body. Once the player has been noticed Harvey says these check-ups are private and asks the player to leave, but [[George]] stops the player and asks them for their opinion on the matter. *"''George should follow Dr. Harvey's advice.''" +40 friendship points. Harvey thanks the player and then tells [[George]] that he's only trying to help him. [[George]] gives in and says he'll do as Harvey says, and Harvey thanks the player for the help. *"''George knows what's best for his own body.''" -40 friendship points. Harvey says it's better not to give his patients mixed messages. [[George]] gives in and says he'll do as Harvey says. '''Cutscene video:''' https://youtu.be/ZdvUxj7OG84 '''Four Hearts''' On Sunday, Tuesday, or Wednesday enter the clinic when Harvey is there. Harvey will be inside and he will explain that he was just about to send the player a letter because they’re overdue for their annual check up. As he preforms the check up he will state that the player’s pulse is high.  *"''I'm a little nervous...''" +20 friendship points. Harvey will assume that the hospital is making the player nervous and tells them to relax and that he's here to help. *"''I'm out of breath from working on the farm.''" +20 friendship points. Harvey says that it makes sense. *"''Are you really a Doctor? My pulse is fine!''" -50 friendship points.  After that he states that the player is healthy and should take care not to overwork themselves on the farm. '''Cutscene video:''' https://youtu.be/wKX4aDFQ_Ho '''Six Hearts''' [[Pierre's General Store]], 11am - 3pm, any weather Enter Pierre's shop to witness the aerobics class (taught by [[Caroline]]) going on with some of the girls of Pelican Town and Harvey. Harvey seems to be out of breath, having some trouble keeping up with their pace. When the session ends he runs into the player and is extremely embarrassed, saying that he didn't want anyone else to know about it. After explaining that he's been trying to keep in shape, which is getting harder with age, he asks that the player refrains from telling the rest of the town about it. *"''I won't tell''" +20 friendship points. Harvey appreciates the player for keeping it a secret. *"''I can't promise that''" -50 friendship points. '''Cutscene video: '''https://youtu.be/OwzxIYVK4Ng '''Eight Hearts''' Go to Harvey's clinic/room to witness him trying to contact an aircraft on the radio. A pilot responds and he is shocked that anyone actually answered. *''Pretend everything is normal.'' - He pretends like everything's normal too. *''Ask him why he's flustered'' - Harvey explains what happened. After that he confesses that he always dreamed of being a pilot, but had to give that up quickly because of his eyesight and fear. '''Cutscene video: '''[https://youtu.be/u19fdjMORSk https://youtu.be/cvbaFaTSm9k] '''Ten Hearts''' Railroad, 9am - 5pm, any weather The player will get a letter from Harvey telling them to meet him at the railroad (could take a couple of days after the relationship is maxed out. If it is raining on the day the player receives the letter Harvey will be there on the next sunny day). Once the player gets there they will see he wanted to surprise them with a hot air balloon ride. *"''This looks like fun! Let's ride!''" -Harvey tells the player to go first. *"''But aren't you afraid of heights?''" -Harvey admits it's true but (if romanced) says that he is determined to do this for the player. If the player showed a romantic interest earlier, the scene ends with Harvey and the player embracing in the hot air balloon. '''Cutscene video: '''https://youtu.be/1xvnPlvb8QU '''Marriage''' To marry someone the player will need to raise their friendship level to 10 hearts, as well as have given them a [[Bouquet of Flowers|bouquet]]. Once the player has the "[[Mermaid's Pendant|Mermaid Pendant]]" bought from the man on the beach, on a rainy day in the zone where they had to repair the bridge, they can go to Harvey. After the player has given the "[[Mermaid's Pendant|Mermaid Pendant]]" to Harvey, the following dialogue is: - "...!!!!" - "I accept!!" - "The ceremony will take place in three days" '''Cutscene video: '''https://youtu.be/69u9om1BWJU ==Daily Routine== ==='''Spring'''===

==Dialogue== *'''First Meeting:''' "It's a pleasure to meet you. I'm Harvey, the local doctor." ===Regular=== *"Hmm... I'm struggling to make ends meet. I don't have enough patients." *"I perform regular check-ups and medical procedures for all the residents of Pelican Town. It's rewarding work." *"I hope you'll find your own work equally rewarding, in time." *"I hate to say this, but I do make a lot more money during flu season. I guess if people stopped getting sick, I'd be out of business. Don't get the wrong idea! I want people to be healthy...really!" *"Feel free to stop by my office if you're ever feeling ill. You're young though, you'll probably stay healthy without trying." *"It's flu season, so you'd better be extra careful. Make sure to wash your hands often." *"It's okay to get a moderate amount of sunlight. Just don't get burnt. Okay. Take care! Stay healthy." ===Festivals=== *'''Luau:''' "Good thing I came with sunscreen. I wonder if Maru could use some sunscreen on her shoulders?" *'''Dance of the Moonlight Jellies:''' "Well, summer's over. To be honest, I'll be happy to say goodbye to those blasted mosquitoes." *'''Festival of Ice:''' "Extreme temperatures can put your body under a lot of stress, so make sure to bundle up! Oh, and enjoy the festival!" ==='''After Marriage'''=== *'''Evening:''' "Good evening... did you finish everything you needed to do today? Don't worry about me. I'm very self-sufficient. If you have more work to do go right ahead." *"Hi [affectionate nickname]! I got up early and fed all the farm animals. I hope it makes your job a little easier today." == Portraits ==

{{Item|Refined Quartz}} }} {{tocright}} '''Sam''' is a [[Villager]] and one of the twelve [[Marriage Candidates]] who lives in the [[Pelican Town]] region of [[Stardew Valley (location)|Stardew Valley]]. He lives with his mother [[Jodi]], his little brother [[Vincent]], and his father [[Kent]] who eventually returns home from the military in year 2. Sam has a disregard for authority, not understanding why he should respect someone he doesn't really know, such as the [[Governor]]. He's not afraid to break rules, and according to [[Sebastian]], he holds the record for most community service hours in the Valley because of this. Sam has a part-time job at [[JojaMart]], and he doesn't seem to enjoy it that much. Still, he does like their [[Joja Cola]] product. On Fridays, he meets up with Sebastian and [[Abigail]] at [[The Stardrop Saloon]] to hang out and play billiards, though he isn't very good at it and often becomes frustrated, much to Sebastian's amusement. While his father is away, Sam worries for his safety and hopes he'll return home in one piece, if at all. ==Family== {| style="width: 400px;" class="article-table" border="0" cellpadding="1" cellspacing="1" |- ! scope="col" |[[File:Jodi.png|left|100px]] ! scope="col" | [[Jodi]] (Mother) |} {| style="width: 400px;" class="article-table" border="0" cellpadding="1" cellspacing="1" |- ! scope="col" |[[File:Kent.png|left|100px]] ! scope="col" | [[Kent]] (Father) |} {| style="width: 400px;" class="article-table" border="0" cellpadding="1" cellspacing="1" |- ! scope="col" |[[File:Vincent.png|left|100px]] ! scope="col" | [[Vincent]] (Brother) |} ==Gifts== ==='''Love'''=== ''"Aw, yea! Sam then says that now they only need to find someone to play the drums. |} '''Cutscene video: '''https://youtu.be/T8v6h-rQ3wI ==='''Three Hearts'''=== Go to the beach while sunny during first year. {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" !''' Sam reassures him their dad will come back. After that Vincent goes off to continue playing, and Sam turns to you and confesses that he's not sure if their dad is ever gonna come back and that their troops are going down rapidly. He asks if you think he did the right thing by lying to Vincent. You then have two response options: *"You did the right thing. {{Item|Quartz}} }} {{tocright}} '''Shane''' is a [[Villager]] and one of the twelve [[Marriage Candidates]] who lives in the [[Cindersap Forest]] region of [[Stardew Valley (location)|Stardew Valley]]. He lives with his aunt [[Marnie]] and rents a room at her [[Marnie's Ranch|ranch]], where he helps out by taking care of the [[Chickens]]. He also works as a stock clerk at [[JojaMart]] and spends his free time at [[The Stardrop Saloon]] in the evenings. Shane seems to suffer from depression, is a heavy drinker, and loves frozen [[Pizza]]. '''Two Hearts'''

After gaining two hearts, you can trigger a cutscene with Shane by going to Marnie's Ranch after 8:00 PM. Shane is on a dock with you and offers you a beer. He goes on to talk about how he feels like a failure, that he's stuck in a pit, and isn't strong enough to get out. He comments bemusedly on how quickly you drink but warns you not to make a habit of it. He then says goodnight and the cutscene ends.

'''Cutscene video: '''https://youtu.be/0AiL6WYyq4A

'''Three Hearts'''

Shane starts sending you recipes that he thinks you'll enjoy. To get half a heart, bring him a recipe he gave you.

'''Four Hearts'''

If you visit his house at 9:00 AM or later you will enter a cut scene of Shane down on the floor out cold (drunk). Marnie will walk in disappointed and after you walk in she will ask you if you can do something, you will go up to him and pour your water can over him. He'll wake up startled and when was Jas walks in Marnie will ask him about his future, he will say he hopes he won't live long enough for that and Jas runs out crying.

'''Five Hearts'''

At some point he will send you a letter in the mail, saying he felt like writing you something but he has no clue what to say to you. To make up for that, he sends you a pizza along with the letter, saying how he stole it from the backroom of his job for you and to keep it a secret.

'''(Current) Six Hearts'''

This event triggers at 6 hearts if you go into Pelican Town after 9:00 AM. You will encounter Shane, Clint, and Emily in Town. Shane is holding a video camera and trying to record a scene with Clint and Emily. Clint can't remember his line and Shane stops recording. He will then notify you and ask you to walk behind Clint and Emily to add authenticity. He does this scene to take part in the Joja advertisement competition for winning 10,000g. You agree and take a position. Shane starts the scene. Everyone is doing their part perfectly. The scene for the competition ends with Clint drinking "Joja Blue". Shane is happy that everything went smoothly but unfortunately Clint will turn blue.

'''Trigger Warning: Suicide'''

'''(Current) Six Hearts'''

After the 1.1 update it has changed. It is triggered in the forest by Marnie’s Ranch after 12:00 AM on a rainy day. He is collapsed on the edge of the cliff near the sewer surrounded by 6-packs of beer. Barely conscious, he talks about how his life is repetitive and how he tries to run from his self-hatred, how he feels the only way to take control of his life is a suicide, but he can't make himself do it. Shane then asks what reason he even has to live

"There's so much to live for." -

"Jas, you're like a father to her." -

"It's a sin." -

"It's your choice, but I'm here for you." -

Shane then asks you to take him to the hospital. When you cut back in, the Doctor says Shane will be physically alright after treatment, but he's concerned about Shane's mental health and is recommending a counselor in Zuzu city. The next day he's waiting outside of your house for you. He is thankful but embarrassed and you can reply:

"Glad I was there to help." -

"You were pretty messed up." -

"I'm just glad you're here." -

He doesn't remember much, but has decided to see the therapist.

'''Cutscene video: '''https://youtu.be/MfwQHXeG1G0

'''Seven Hearts'''

Triggers when you enter Marnie's Ranch after 9:00 AM. Marnie says Shane looks happier than he has in a long time and asks if there was a discount beer sale. Shane replies with no, he's been drinking Sparkling Water instead and that he's been depending on his friends, and that's okay. He then gifts Jas a pair of bunny-jewel slippers. She mentions they're expensive and asks how he afforded them. He replies that he's cut back on an expensive habit.

'''Eight Hearts'''

Triggers when you enter Marnie's Ranch after 9:00 AM. Jas is waiting for you to tell you Shane wants to show you something, then leads you through the door that is always locked. Shane interacts with the only non-blue chicken for a bit until you walk in. When you enter he shows you that he has blue chickens, and talks about how he's been breeding them so that he contributes to the world, mentioning how he has been teaching Jas to care for them.

'''Ten Hearts '''

He meets you in the morning and asks you to "The Tunnelers" game with him. If you meet him at the bus stop at 5:00 the bus will be miraculously fixed, even if you haven't completed the bundles. At the Tunnelers game, he gives you a beer and asks how you like the game.

"It's noisy, I prefer Pelican Town." -

"I like it, it's too quiet in the country." -

When the Tunnelers score he gives you a peck on the cheek and promptly blames it on the beer. Not putting up with that, you kiss him right back, this time on the lips. Afterwards he says it was a good game... "Oh, and we won too."
