  '''•'''   {{Item|Void Egg}} }} {{tocright}} '''Sebastian''' is a [[Villager]] and one of the twelve [[Marriage Candidates]] who lives in the [[Mountain]] region of [[Stardew Valley (location)|Stardew Valley]]. He lives in the basement of the [[Carpenter's Shop]] with his mom [[Robin]], his half-sister [[Maru]], and his stepfather [[Demetrius]]. He tends to feel unappreciated compared to his sister, who is regarded highly both by his parents and other villagers. His residence in the shop's basement seems to further isolate him, and it seems he's not a fan of it either, as he often makes the comment "''Maybe my room would be less depressing if I had a window...''". If married to the player, he'll often comment about [[The Farm]] being much more pleasant in comparison. He's not a very social person and expresses in his first heart event that he needs time to himself. Despite this, Sebastian is good friends with both [[Sam]] and [[Abigail]], whom he hangs out with at the [[Stardrop Saloon]] on Friday evenings. He often plays billiards against Sam and usually wins, finding amusement in Sam's lack of skill. He also plays the keyboard in a band with Sam, who he eventually convinces to include Abigail as their drummer. He has a bit of an "emo" attitude, preferring darkness to the light and having an interest in things most people consider creepy. He's rather philosophical and often ponders death, the purpose of life, etc. It's speculated that he may suffer from depression and social anxiety. He and Sam are both a bit rebellious, but Sebastian's a bit quieter about it. He has an interest in science fiction and fantasy and enjoys reading books and graphic novels, as well as programming computer games and playing tabletop role-playing games. He also owns a motorcycle and seems to do maintenance on it semi-frequently. He smokes; at the [[Stardew Valley Fair]], the player can see him holding an orange and white stick to his mouth and breathing out smoke. At the train station on some days, you can see him smoke. When you get married to him, he gives up smoking but depending on your hearts with him he can take up smoking again. Sebastian works as a freelance programmer and expresses frustration that his job not taken seriously by others. He feels discontent in the valley and hopes to leave for the city someday. == Appearance == Sebastian has a slim build, pale skin, and messy blackish-purple hair that falls over one side of his face. His eyes are a muted violet-grey, and he usually has a distant or tired expression that matches his introverted personality. === Outfits === ===== Normal ===== His regular outfit is a dark grey hoodie with the hood down, paired with black slim pants and black shoes. The look is simple but leans toward an emo or alternative style, which reflects his quiet and somewhat rebellious nature. ===== Winter ===== In winter, his hoodie is replaced with a longer, dark black coat. He still wears his usual dark pants and shoes. === '''Heart Events and how to trigger (Spoilers)''' ===
'''2 Hearts:''' The player can go to Sebastian's room while he’s there and they will get to chat about his work (he’s a programmer). The event continues and he gets annoyed because nobody takes his job seriously. Cutscene: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5WFTjmynp-I] '''4 Hearts:''' Head to the mountain between 11am and 5pm to find Sebastian working on a motorcycle. He asks the player if they would like to go on a ride at some point and they can agree or disagree with no negative hit to their friendship. [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=m6lQysQ09J8] '''6 Hearts:''' if the player goes to Sebastian’s room while he’s there, they will get to play a game with him. They must choose a class, then go in through the front, defend yourself, enter the hallway to the left, destroy the capsules, and enter the boss battle. Their last choice depends on their class: if they’re a wizard, defend their friends while the wizard is mumbling, if they’re a healer then heal Sebastian, and if they’re a warrior, block him. Cutscene: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fWT7Q7Ln8dk] '''8 Hearts''': Head to the boardwalk when it’s raining between 12pm and 11pm to trigger a cutscene where Sebastian opens up a bit. Cutscene: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Oh29Ig0bz7s] '''10 Hearts:''' If the player goes to the mountain between 8pm and midnight, they’ll get to go on a ride with Sebastian to a place he really likes, and they can tell him he should quit smoking if they would like to. He also confesses his feelings for them. Cutscene: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0Meoeq3xDGo] '''14 Hearts:''' if the player goes to the mountain between 6am and 7pm while it's raining, they’ll get to have a conversation with Sebastian about a frog. They can start the second part of this event by going to their farmhouse between 6:20am and 7pm the next day. Now they will have a terarium and they can encourage Sebastian to get a frog if they’d like. Cutscene: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=66MaIf-x1pY] == Portraits ==

== Events == '''Above 1 Heart'''[[File:Clint3Heart.JPG|thumb|836x836px]] Clint can send you a copper, iron or gold bar in the mail. The type of bar is randomly chosen when you open your mail. The higher your friendship is with him the higher chance you have to receive this in your mailbox. '''3 Hearts''' After gaining 3 hearts, Clint will send you a recipe for "[[Algae Soup]]" in the mail 'to help with your mining trips'. There will also be a confession scene where Clint confesses that he is not good at interacting with women and asks for the player's advice. The response may affect his affection for you. This event occurs at the [[Stardrop Saloon]], from 7pm to 11pm in any weather. The possible responses and friendship point changes are: *"Impress women with your strength and charm." +25 friendship points. *"Act crazy, to keep people guessing." +25 friendship points. *"Just act natural... be yourself." no change friendship points. *"Treat women the same as men" +50 friendship points. '''6 Hearts''' (''This event will not occur if you are married to Emily, or have seen her Eight Heart Event or Ten Heart event.'') Entering town from Marnie's Ranch side will trigger a cutscene where clint finally asks Emily out. This cutscene will only appear if you've done the [[Stardrop Saloon]] heart event. '''7 Hearts''' After gaining 7 hearts, Clint will send you a recipe for "[[Bean Hotpot]]" in the mail. ==Dialogue== ===First Meeting=== "Er...hi. I'm Clint." ... "I'm the town blacksmith. If you ever need to upgrade your tools, I'm your guy." ===Regular=== "Yep, I'm a blacksmith."..."My father was also a blacksmith."..."My grandfather was a blacksmith as well. And yes my great-grandfather was also a blacksmith." "Today would be a good day to explore the mines... Who knows, you might find some rare ores." ===Questions=== I bet you can't guess what my great-grandfather was... -A blacksmith - " How'd you know? " -A silly clown - " Ahaha, good one! " -A sarcastic jerk. - " Wow. That was rude. I was just being funny and you took it to a whole new level. " ===Festivals=== '''Egg Festival''' *"Is there anymore food?" '''Luau''' *"I'm full, but what else is there to do besides eat"? '''Dance of the Moonlight Jellies''' *"I wore my special shoes tonight...no one noticed." '''Festival of Ice''' *"[[Emily]] starting helping me without any provocation...does that mean something? *gulp*" == Portraits ==

'''Ice Festival''' *"I'm sorry, but carving ice parapets requires my undivided attention." == Quest == On the 11th day of spring you will get a letter in the mail asking if anybody can return Robin's axe to her. Upon accepting the quest a log will be added to your journal. The axe can be found in Cindersap Forest About 10 paces north then 10 paces east of the sewer drain, just under the cliff to the very right. Talking to Robin with the axe in your inventory will get you a snarky remark about almost cutting off her toe and G250 [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BLwyZNoGETU Where to Find Robin's Lost Axe] == Events == Go into Robins carpentry shop. Robin: "Demetrius, I didn't tell you to get tomatoes. I said to get fruit." Demetrius: "I don't understand. Tomatoes are fruits!" Robin: "When a normal person says they want a fruit, they NEVER mean tomatoes. It doesn't matter what the scientific classification is." You walk in. Demetrius: "YOUR NAME HERE! I'm glad you're here. You'll be able to put this argument to rest." === Choices === How would you classify a tomato? ===== '''Vegetable''' ===== * Demetrius: "Really? I figured a farmer would know the correct answer..."I just want you to understand my point of view. It's hard for me to know exactly what assumptions I should make when you tell me something. But I'll try to get better at it. Thanks for your help, YOUR NAME HERE. ===== '''Fruit''' ===== * Demetrius: "See? YOUR NAME HERE agrees with me. I just want you to understand my point of view. He states that the collections were once prosperous with [[artifacts]] until the previous owner took everything with him, and asks the player to bring any donations they find. The player will receive unique rewards for reaching certain milestones and also for some specific donations. A cut scene with [[Jas]] and [[Vincent]] playing at the entrance to [[The Sewers]] in the [[Cindersap Forest]] eventually reveals to the player that Gunther has the [[Rusty Key]] to get in. == Daily Routine == Gunther sits in the museum/library all day, awaiting donations. He is not seen anywhere else in the game. == Quests ==

{{Item|Topaz}} }} {{tocright}} '''Dwarf''' is a non-marriage [[villager]] living in eastern cavern of [[The Mines|The Mines']] entrance area, located in the [[Mountain]] region of [[Stardew Valley (location)|Stardew Valley]]. He can also be found later on the fifth floor in the [[Volcano Dungeon]], located in the northern region of [[Ginger Island]]. The cavern room in The Mines where the Dwarf is first met can be accessed after destroying the sparkly boulder that bars the path, and can be done using a pickaxe of at least steel quality, or by exploding one any bomb beside it (not including [[Explosive Ammo]] with the [[Slingshot]]). Dwarf will sell various and unique items that are otherwise difficult to acquire, like the [[Rarecrow|Rarecrow #6]] which one of 8 rare and unique [[Scarecrow]]s. Dwarf will be speaking Dwarvish when he first meets the player, and the [[Dwarvish Translation Guide]] must be read to understand him. The language [[book]] can be received as a reward for donating all [[artifact]] scrolls ([[Dwarf Scroll I]], [[Dwarf Scroll II]], [[Dwarf Scroll III]], and [[Dwarf Scroll IV]]) to [[Gunther]] at the [[Museum]]. Until the player can understand him, Dwarf will not be able to gain [[Friendship]] or receive [[Gifts]]. ==Gifts== === Loves: === "Hey, I really love this stuff. You can find great things in the mines." "A punhaan nuh? Xha's zinan mu oh anoe! V ozi u.h." [[Amethyst]], [[Aquamarine]], [[Emerald]], [[Jade]], [[Omni Geode]], [[Ruby]], [[Topaz]] ===Likes:=== "Ah, this reminds me of home." [[Apple]], [[Apricot]], [[Beer]], [[Blackberry Cobbler]], [[Corn]], [[Cheese]], [[Chocolate Cake]], [[Cloth]], [[Coffee]], [[Cookies]], [[Cranberry Candy|Cranberry Candy,]] Cranberry Sauce, [[Crocus]], [[Diamond]], [[Frozen Tear]], [[Fire Quartz]], Dwarvish Helm, Dwarf Gadget, Dwarf scrolls 1-4, [[Earth Crystal]], [[Eggplant]], [[Ice Cream]], [[Jade]], [[Jelly]](Blackberry, Blueberry), [[Juice]](Eggplant), [[Mayonnaise]] (All), Omelet, [[Orange|Orange,]] [[Pale Ale]], [[Parsnip]], [[Pickle]]s(Tomato), [[Pizza]], [[Quartz]], [[Sashimi]], [[Sweet Pea]], [[Tomato]], Trout Soup, [[Tulip]], [[Wild Honey]], [[Wine]](Blackberry, Hot Pepper, Strawberry) spaghetti, ===Dislikes:=== "Hmm... Is this what humans like?" All greens, [[Blackberry]], [[Blueberry]], [[Cave Carrot]], [[Clam]], [[Clay]], [[Cockle]], [[Coconut]], [[Common Mushroom]], [[Coral]], Cranberries, Crayfish, Daffodil, Dandelion, Eggs (All), fairy stone,Fiber, Field Snack, Gold Bar, Grape, Green Algae, Hardwood, Holly, Hops, Hot Pepper, Kyanite, Magma Geode, Milk (All), Nautilus Shell, Refined Quartz, Salmonberry, Spice Berry, Spring Onion, Stone, Thunder Egg, Void Egg, Wild Horseradish, Wild Plum ===Hates:=== "I don't care what species you are. This is worthless garbage." All [[Trash|junk]], All [[Bait]], Ancient Drum, [[Bat Wing]], [[Bug Meat]], [[Green Algae]], [[Iron Ore]], [[Sea Urchin]], [[Slime]] ==Rain== The Dwarf has dialogue specific to rainy weather. "Rain... It's almost mythical to us. Some of us dwarves live our entire life without ever experiencing it." ==Heart Event== At Zero hearts (+50 Friendship Points) there is an event in [[The Sewers]] between the Dwarf, [[Krobus]], and the [[Wizard]]. Just ask me if you need anything." |villager = yes |location = Calico Desert |location2 = Ginger Island |address = Casino |address2 = Qi's Walnut Room |work = Mystery }} {{tocright}} '''Mr. Qi''' is a non-marriage [[villager]] found at the [[Casino]] in the [[Calico Desert]], and his primary role is to give a variety of [[quests]], challenges, and to unlock secrets. He can also be found in [[Qi's Walnut Room]] on [[Ginger Island]], after the player has found at least 100 [[Golden Walnut]]s to gain passage. == Daily Routine == Mr. Qi is always in both the Casino and his Walnut Room. == Quests == After unlocking the [[Skull Cavern]], the [[Qi's Challenge]] quest is received from Mr. Qi. After reaching floor 25 in the cavern, the player is rewarded with {{Price|10000}}. Placing a [[Battery Pack]] into the secret lock-box discovered in [[The Tunnel]] (west of the [[Bus Stop]]) will drop a note, beginning the quest [[The Mysterious Qi]]. The player is then set out on a series of tasks to complete, each beginning with a note found from the last objective. They are, in order: * Leave a [[Rainbow Shell]] in the train station's box at the [[Railroad]]. * Place ten [[Beet]]s inside [[Lewis']] fridge in [[Mayor's Manor]]. * Give a [[Solar Essence]] to the mouth of the large dragon skeleton found in the [[Calico Desert]]. * Examine the pile of lumber beside the player's [[Farmhouse]]. After completing the quest, a [[Club Card]] is given to the player and access to the Casino is unlocked. == Casino == :''See [[Casino]] for further information. == Walnut Room == :''See [[Qi's Walnut Room]] for further information. == Quotes ==

{{Item|Wine}} }} {{tocright}} '''Leo''' is one of the three [[villager]]s that are children, and is first met living in the jungle on [[Ginger Island]]. His parents were lost at sea, and he considers the parrots on the island to be his family. When the player first discovers the island, he is too shy to speak to them, until the player "makes friends" with the parrots of the island by giving [[Golden Walnuts]] to the first parrot seen by the large turtle blocking an eastward path. Once the player reaches six hearts with Leo, he moves to the town of [[Stardew Valley (location)|Stardew Valley]], where he befriends [[Linus]], [[Vincent]], and [[Jas]]. == Relationships == On Ginger Island, Leo is friends with the parrots, who he also considers his family. Once Leo moves to Stardew Valley, he bonds with Linus and begins attending [[Penny]]'s lessons with [[Vincent]] and [[Jas]]. Based on some of his dialogue, it's suggested that he has a crush on Jas. == Gifts == === Loved gifts === ''"I love this. I'm going to put it in my nest."'' All [[Universal Loves]], [[Duck Feather]], [[Mango]], [[Ostrich Egg]], [[Poi]]. === Liked gifts === ''"Are you sure? This is so nice..."'' All [[Universal Likes]] (except for [[Beer]], [[Coffee]], [[Mead]], [[Pale Ale]], [[Piña Colada]], [[Wine]], and [[Cooking]], other than [[Bread]], [[Fried Egg]], [[Poi]], [[Mango Sticky Rice]], and [[Triple Shot Espresso]]), [[Dragon Tooth]], [[Mango Sticky Rice]], [[Nautilus Shell]], [[Quartz]], [[Rainbow Shell]], [[Sea Urchin]], [[Spice Berry]]. === Neutral gifts === ''"I accept your gift''." All [[Universal Neutrals]] (except for Duck Feather, [[Hops]], Nautilus Shell, and Rainbow Shell), all eggs (except Ostrich and [[Void Egg]]), all [[Fish]], all [[fruit]] (except Mango, Salmonberry, and Spice Berry), all [[milk]], [[Coffee]]. === Disliked gifts === ''"Oh...I don't know if I can digest this..."'' All [[Universal Dislikes]] (except for [[Oil]], [[Unmilled Rice]], and Fish), All [[Cooking|Cooked]] dishes (other than Bread, Fried Egg, Poi, Mango Sticky Rice, and Triple Shot Espresso), [[Chanterelle]], [[Common Mushroom]], [[Daffodil]], [[Dandelion]], [[Ginger]], [[Hazelnut]], [[Leek]], [[Magma Cap]], [[Pickles]], [[Purple Mushroom]], [[Salmonberry]], [[Snow Yam]], [[Wild Horseradish|Wild Horseradish,]] [[Winter Root]]. === Hated gifts === ''"*sniff* *sniff* ... why are you giving this to me? Do you want me to bury it for you?"'' All [[Universal Hates]] (except for [[Dragon Tooth]] and [[Sea Urchin]]), [[Beer]], [[Holly]], [[Hops]], [[Mead]], [[Morel]], [[Oil]], [[Pale Ale]], [[Piña Colada]], [[Triple Shot Espresso]], [[Unmilled Rice]], [[Wine]]. == Heart Events == === Two Hearts === Enter West Island on a sunny day. The player is standing by the shore when Leo approaches them from behind. He asks what the player is doing. * '''Just enjoying the waves.''' ''(No effect on friendship.)'' * '''Looking for fish.''' ''(No effect on friendship.)'' * '''Thinking about someone special.''' ''(No effect on friendship.)'' * '''Pondering the big questions.''' ''(No effect on friendship.)'' Leo then asks what the player's home is like. * '''There's a town full of people.''' ''(No effect on friendship.)'' * '''There's forests, beaches, and mountains.''' ''(No effect on friendship.)'' * '''It's like here, but colder.''' ''(No effect on friendship.)'' * '''I live on a farm.''' ''(No effect on friendship.)'' Leo thinks about your words for a bit before asking if there are any kids in Pelican Town * '''Yes.''' ''(No effect on friendship.)'' * '''What does that matter to a bird?''' ''(No effect on friendship.)'' Regardless of the answer, Leo says he's aware he's not really a bird, and he tries to avoid thinking about it because it makes him feel lonely. He tries to fit in with the parrots, but knows he truly doesn't belong anywhere. He runs off before Willy enters the scene, wondering if there's any way to help him. === Three Hearts === Leo sends the player a recipe for Poi in the mail. === Four Hearts === Enter [[Island North]] on a sunny day between 6am and 6pm. The player approaches Leo from behind. Leo squawks like a parrot and startles the player, which startles Leo in turn. Leo then apologizes and explains that he has difficulty communicating using words, then asks the player if they find him weird. Leo wonders about the differences in his life if he hadn't been washed ashore and wonders about what "normal kids" would have to say about him. Leo then asks the player if they think he could ever be a normal kid again. After the player answers, he states that he's happy he met the parrots regardless, and that he will always consider them family no matter what. Leo thanks the player for talking to him and says that the player may be a part of his family too, someday. He then teaches the player how to say "let's play" in parrot-talk. Note that none of the dialogue options in this cutscene affect friendship with Leo. === Six Hearts === Enter [[Island South]] on a sunny day between 6am and 6pm. Linus invites Leo to move to the mainland of Stardew Valley. Willy says that there are other children there, and Leo can visit Ginger Island anytime he wants to. Willy asks the player what they think. (Choices have no effect on friendship). Leo decides to move to Stardew Valley. That night, parrots build him a treehouse in the tree to the left of Linus' tent. === Seven Hearts === Leo will send the player a recipe for Mango Sticky Rice in the mail. === Nine Hearts === Enter the Mountain on a non-rainy day between 6am and 7pm. Leo is shown adjusting well to life in Stardew Valley. He is seen cooking a bean hotpot with Linus on the campfire. In the next scene, he is at school at the library/museum with Penny, Vincent and Jas answering a question correctly. Another scene shows him fishing with Willy. The scene after has him watching Jas from the bushes in the playground, and running away when she notices. He arrives home at the treehouse and talks to his parrot friend about how good his day was, but he still misses Ginger Island. == Portraits ==

{{Item|Wine}} }} {{tocright}} '''Penny''' is a [[Villager]] and one of the twelve [[Marriage Candidates]] who lives in the [[Pelican Town]] region of [[Stardew Valley (location)|Stardew Valley]]. Penny lives with her mother, [[Pam]], in a little [[trailer]] by the river. While Pam is out carousing at [[Stardrop Saloon]], Penny quietly tends to her chores in the dim, stuffy trailer she is forced to call her home. Penny is shy, modest, and reserved, lacking any grand ambitions for her life other than moving out of the trailer and starting a family. She likes to [[cook]] (although her skills are questionable) and read books at the local [[library]]. She also serves as a teacher to [[Vincent]] and [[Jas]] (and later [[Leo]] after he moves into the town), which she admits isn't always easy though still enjoys it. While the player is travelling through the town during the day, it's very likely they will cross paths with Penny leading the kids around [[Pelican Town]] or giving them lessons in the library. == Family == {| class="article-table" style="width: 400px;" border="0" cellpadding="1" cellspacing="1" |- ! scope="col" |[[File:Pam.png|thumb|left|100px]] ! ! scope="col" | [[Pam]] (Mother) ! ! |}

[[George]] is trying to access his mailbox but cannot reach a letter, Penny walks up and assists him, but then he complains about it. The farmer can side with Penny, [[George]], or remain neutral neither adding nor subtracting friendship points. * "I was. You did a kind thing there, Penny." (+50 friendship points.) * "I was. You should've asked instead of assuming George wanted help." (-50 friendship points.) * "I'm just taking a walk, minding my own business." (No effect on friendship) Regardless of your choice, George will apologize to Penny for getting angry. He comments on how it was very kind of her to help. Penny says she understands. After George leaves, Penny says it must be difficult growing old. '''Cutscene video:''' https://youtu.be/1rKDAQLrGO8 '''Four Hearts''' Enter Penny's Trailer when she's home. Penny complains about how messy the trailer is, and asks if you could help clean it up. The player automatically accepts. As you do so, Pam returns home and yells at Penny for having someone else clean the trailer. Pam eventually asks you to leave, and they continue their discussion privately. Pam admits she's embarrassed to have strangers clean up the house. The next day, you get an apology letter from Penny. '''Cutscene video''': https://youtu.be/Kbegm1AxQHQ '''Six Hearts''' Enter [[Pam]] and Penny's trailer at midday when only Penny is there to trigger the event. Penny is just finishing cooking a new recipe she invented. She gives you a taste of her food to eat, and the player takes a bite. Judging from how green you become the food must be terrible. Regardless of your choice you and Penny simply settle on watching a movie for the evening, however, your answer will affect her affection meter. * "(Lie) Mmm! That was delicious!" (+50 friendship points.) *"Uh... can I get the rest to go?" (-50 friendship points.) * "Well it's definitely unique... how did you get it so rubbery?" (No change in friendship points.) Afterward she thanks you for being her taste-tester and suggests you watch a movie. '''[https://youtu.be/-bH6PhV6zxc Cutscene video]''' '''Eight Hearts''' Enter Cindersap Forest, 9am - 4pm, any weather Enter Cindersap Forest while Penny is on her "free time". She will be having a picnic with [[Jas]] and [[Vincent|Vincent,]] playing by the water. Penny states she brought the children on a field trip, so she asks the player if they can be her guest speaker for the children and talk about country life. Your response will affect her affection for you. * "I'd love to!" (+10 friendship points.) * "Sure." (No change in friendship points.) * "No... I can't stand kids." (-1500 friendship points.) She proceeds to teach the children about the subject but then she calls the player to speak and the player is given a series of things to say to the children. Depending on your answers the kids will ask different questions. Afterward, Penny talks to the player about how it's tough to teach the kids, however, she doesn't mind and actually enjoys seeing them grow and learn new things. She then asks you if you want kids of your own. Your response will affect her affection for you. * "I haven't really thought about it." (No change in friendship points.) * "Absolutely. I want a big family." (+20 friendship points.) * "I guess so. It's a natural urge." (+20 friendship points.) * "No, I don't think I'd be good at it." (+10 friendship points.) * "No, The world's crowded enough already." (-10 friendship points.) * "No, I don't want to be tied down with a family." (-10 friendship points.) '''Cutscene video''': https://youtu.be/D-9B_BjEIdg '''Ten Hearts''' Spa, 7pm - 12am, any weather Penny will send you a message asking you to meet her in the bathhouse after dark. When you arrive she will ask you if you know why she asked you here. Penny will then tell the player her true feelings for them. Your response may affect her affection for you. * "I feel the same way about you." - No change in friendship points. * "Sorry, but I don't like you in that way..." - -1500 friendship points. '''Cutscene video: '''https://youtu.be/7hHLV-ioz_k '''Marriage''' On a rainy day, you must go to the east part of the beach (only accessible after donating 300 wood to fix the bridge) and talk to the [[Old Mariner]]. If the player has their house upgraded enough he will sell you a [[Mermaid's Pendant]]. Should the player gift to the pendant to Penny, she will agree to marry you and ask for three days to prepare the ceremony. After the wedding, she will move in with you. '''Cutscene video: '''https://youtu.be/Poy8ud_iFIo '''14 Hearts''' When you come home from work Penny will ask you about your day and give you something to eat. After the food, she will start asking if she can redecorate your bedroom. ==Dialogue== ===First Meeting=== "Hi..." ... "Oh, did you want something? ===Regular=== "We're lucky to have a library in a small town like this." "The raindrops on the roof of our trailer are really loud... But it's soothing!" "I'm eager to move out. It's such a burden to be worrying about Mom all the time." "I want her to be happy, but I can't stay here forever... you know?" "Things changed a lot after the JojaMart went up. It's been really bad for [[Pierre's General Store|Pierre's shop]]. Mom loves JojaMart, though. The prices are cheap, so she can afford a lot more there than she ever could at Pierre's." "Hi. Ummm... The weather's interesting today, don't you think? Sorry..." "This town's safe, but I always walk the children home anyway." ===Questions=== "My mother spends to much time at the saloon... But it's best not to dwell on bad things, right?" ''Right. It's best to be positive! '' OR '' I think it's good to be realistic. '' ===Festivals=== '''Luau''' *"We do this festival every year to give the governor a taste of everything the valley has to offer. Mayor Lewis hopes it will get the governor on our good side. That's why he'so neurotic about the way the soup tastes." '''Dance of the Moonlight Jellies''' *"Life is so easy for a jellyfish...just letting the waves carry you onward forever." '''Festival of Ice''' You find Penny over by the snowmen with Jas.
She asks you "Hmm... What kind of snowman should we make?
Dialogue Options: 1. A classic one. Carrot nose, top-hat, scarf. (''No effect on friendship'') * Response: "I guess maybe it's best to stick with the classics, huh? 2. Something funky. Icicle antennas, pine cone eyes. (''No effect on friendship'') * Response: "Okay, That sounds like fun!" 3. Snowmen are boring. Think outside of the box! (''No effect on friendship'') * Response: "Um, Okay... I think I might stick with something more conventional." == Fun Fact == If you will look on the portrait when chating with Penny you could see that she is wearing yellow shirt but when you are walking next to her you would see that she have a yellow shirt with green collar and purple belt.

Eventually, the player might be asked who is in the right. * "Stop whining and just clean it!" - -20 friendship points. Haley angrily storms off, and Emily cleans the cushions. * "Haley, why not have this be your one weekly job?" - +30 friendship points. Both agree, although Haley isn't happy about it. * "Emily, take the high road and do it this time" - -20 friendship points. Haley is upset that you suggested she is being childish, and Emily cleans the cushions. '''Cutscene video:''' https://youtu.be/nyO_rS8Ytiw '''Four Hearts''' When the player enters her house, a cut scene may start of her struggling to open a jar begins. She might ask the player to open the jar for her. * "Yes," - +30 friendship points. * "No." - -30 friendship points. After opening the jar, Haley probably tells the player that the player is stronger than they look. ''*Usually, the next day, she will tell the player that she got a tool to open jars for her.*'' '''Cutscene video:''' https://youtu.be/AsySC_Kxh0E '''Six Hearts''' Beach, 10am - 4pm, any weather, any season but winter Upon visiting the beach, a cut scene will likely begin where Haley talks about her great-grandmother's bracelet that she's could have lost and the player tries finding it for her. * "Relax, I'll just buy you a new one!" - -30 friendship points. Haley says, "No you won't! This bracelet was passed down to me by my great-grandmother!" * "I'm really sorry..." - +50 friendship points. Haley says, "*sigh* ...Maybe it'll wash up on another shore. I can't bear to think of it at the bottom of the ocean." The bracelet can be located to the right of Elliott's Cabin on the beach behind a shrub. Once turning in the bracelet, Haley could hug the player, possibly thanking them and telling them she won't forget what they've done. '''Cutscene video:''' https://youtu.be/ecZC8EE6H6w '''Eight Hearts''' [[File:Picture_with_Haley.png|thumb|One of the pictures the player's character and Haley take together.]] The player can meet Haley at Marnie's ranch as she is taking photos. She may ask the player to take some pictures with her and asks how to approach a cow. She could climb on one, falls off and gets messy. Haley giggles and could leave to take a shower (slightly raises affection). '''Cutscene video:''' https://youtu.be/H_bjAwXy8Lg. '''Ten''' '''Hearts''' Meet Haley in her house. She will show the player her darkroom. * "It looks great!" - +10 friendship points. * "What does it do?" - No change in friendship points. * "I've seen better." - -50 friendship points. Haley asks what you want to do. * ''Offer to help decorate the dark room'' - No effect on friendship. This response ends the scene and disappoints Haley. If you talk to her immediately after the cutscene, she says, "Well, the dark room looks great now. Thanks, [player]." with her annoyed portrait. * ''Make an excuse and leave'' - No effect on friendship. The player leaves the dark room, leaving Haley by herself. If you talk to her immediately afterwards, she responds, "I thought you had more important things to do..." with her bothered portrait. * ''Try to kiss her.'' - No effect on friendship. Haley says, "Oh, [player]... I've been waiting so long for you to do that. One moment..." Haley flips the light switch, leaving the room dark except for where you two are standing, while both of you lean in for a kiss before the cutscene ends. '''Cutscene video:''' https://youtu.be/2GtGR0nJTXM '''Fourteen Hearts (Pt 1)''' Enter town between 8am to 3pm when it's not raining. Haley overhears a conversation with Penny, Jas and Vincent. Jas complains about her math notebook cover falling off. Penny notices that all off the books are falling apart, and says "New books are expensive, so we just have to make do with what we have..." Vincent asks "Does this mean I don't have to do my homework?" '''Fourteen Hearts (Pt 2)''' At least one day later enter the farm house between 6:30am to 5pm. Haley says she wants to do a town cake walk for charity and asks you to bring a [[Chocolate Cake]] There are two answers: * Yes. Haley replies "Great! I'll meet you in town square tomorrow, weather permitting." * Yes (Begrudgingly). Haley replies " What's up with the snarky attitude? Fine. Your going to show up with a [[Chocolate Cake]] tomorrow, or else your in the dog house. You like that better?" Haley says she is bringing a [[Pink Cake]]. The "Haley's Cake-Walk" quest is added to the journal. '''Marriage''' Requires the [[Mermaid's Pendant|mermaid's pendant]] to propose. {{Item|The Art O' Crabbing}} |uhates = {{Item|Seafoam Pudding}} }} {{tocright}} '''Willy''' is a non-marriage [[Villager]] who lives at and operates the [[Fish Shop]] at [[The Beach]] in [[Stardew Valley (location)|Stardew Valley]]. His familial connections are unknown, but is friends with [[Elliott]] and [[Clint]]. He is the local fisherman and can be found in his [[shop]] daily. He will often be found fishing before and after opening/closing his store, or at the local [[Saloon]] on many evenings. Willy spent most of his life traveling the Fern Islands archipelago (which includes [[Ginger Island]]) before settling down near [[Pelican Town]] in the Valley. He sells bait and other fishing supply items in his shop, which is open every day excluding Saturdays. If the weather is pleasant, he will instead spend Saturdays fishing. == Schedule == Most days Willy wakes up at about 6:10 AM, and fishes at the beach for a few hours before operating his fish shop between 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM. He'll often do more fishing on the beach after closing up shop until about 10:00 PM. During winter he'll go to the saloon instead of the beach after work. On the 9th of Spring, he has an appointment at the clinic. Willy's shop is closed on Saturday while he's out fishing unless it's raining, in which case he'll keep the shop opened. His schedule can deviate if there are specific conditions like season, weather, or certain days of the week. Below are his schedule deviations prioritized highest to lowest (for example when it rains that schedule will override all others below it)

{{Clear}} ==Trivia== Willy has caught Legend before, he just let it go free. What you don't know is that you're not the first one who ever caught Legend. Willy did, when he was just a teenager. It was an epic fight; battling for what seemed like hours. After weeks of failed attempts, of snapped lines, of spent bait, he finally hauled the great fish out of the water. And, looking at him, seeing the beautiful fish in all its glory, as it gave a great, mighty kick... he felt sad, in a way, to see Goliath fall. That, having caught him now, he would forever be caught. And so he let him go. And so, whenever Willy returned home from his fishing trips, every spring, he would return to the mountain lake. Every spring, he caught him. Every spring, the two adversaries would see each other, size themselves up, and then he would let him go again, only to promise to catch him the next year. {{Villagers}} [[Category:Villagers]] [[de:Willy]] [[pl:Willy]] [[ru:Вилли]] [[uk:Віллі]] [[vi:Willy]]

Truly a remarkable place!" |villager = yes |location = Ginger Island |address = Island Field Office |work = Archaeology }} {{tocright}} '''Professor Snail''' is a non-marriage [[villager]] who lives on [[Ginger Island]], and is the sole operator of the [[Island Field Office]]. He tasks the player with collecting various archaeological items from around the Island, and take surveys of the environment. The player will earn unique rewards, given as gifts from the professor for completing collections. == Daily Schedule == Professor Snail is always found at the Island Field Office tent, awaiting specimen donations. After he has been rescued from the [[Mushroom Cave]] near the [[Digsite]], he is not seen anywhere else in the game outside of his tent. == Quests ==

  '''•'''   {{Item|Void Mayonnaise}} }} {{tocright}} '''Krobus''' is a non-marriage [[Villager]] who lives in [[The Sewers]] beneath [[Pelican Town]]. Even though Krobus cannot be married, the player may ask him to move in to the [[Farmhouse]] as a roommate later in their [[Friendship]]. He is always found in the same room in the Sewers day or night, and sells rare items and has both a fixed and rotating stock. Krobus does not appear to have any familial connections, yet he admits later that he is a shadow person, the same as [[Shadow Brute]]s first encountered in [[The Mines]]. Despite being the only friendly [[Monster]], he still refers to his other kin as being friends. In one of his dialogue choices he states, "I am different than the others", and shares that his kind have learned to fear humans. == Shop == Krobus's shop remains open at all times, including during festival days. == Relationships == Krobus typically remains hidden from view and does not engage with other villagers. He harbors a strong aversion to dwarves, citing a recently concluded millennium-long conflict between his kind and theirs. Krobus fears that if the dwarves were to discover his location, they would dispatch an assassin to eliminate him. The Wizard recognizes Krobus's situation and takes measures to avert any potential confrontations. == Gifts == You can give Krobus up to two gifts per week (plus one on his birthday), which will raise or lower his friendship with you. Gifts on his birthday (Winter 1) will have 8× effect and show a unique dialogue. === Love === ''This is an amazing gift. It's always a joy to visit Stardew Valley." |villager = yes |location = Pelican Town |family = Unknown ("The Missus") |friends = [[File:Lewis Icon.png|20px|link=]] [[Lewis]] |work = Being the Governor }} {{tocright}} The '''Governor''' appears every year in [[Summer]] 11 for the [[Luau]] event hosted on [[The Beach]] in [[Stardew Valley (location)|Stardew Valley]]. During the event, he will test the community's potluck soup, which the player has a choice to add in an ingredient before it's tasted. There are several ingredient options in the game that have unique results, changing how the event will end. The Governor is mostly seen at the Luau event, but may cross paths with player at the [[Movie Theater]] as well. == Relationships == In his dialogue, the Governor refers to his "missus". It is unknown if this is his wife or not. The Governor cannot be gifted to, married, or gain [[Friendship]] with the player. == Luau == {{Quote|What a lovely occasion... It's always a joy to visit Stardew Valley. I must speak to the missus about purchasing a vacation home here.}} {{Quote|Of course! I've been looking forward to this all year.}} The Governor will have different responses after tasting the potluck soup, depending on what the player chose to add as an ingredient. === Best Soup === {{Quote|Oh my... that's the best soup I've ever tasted!}} Aim for iridium or gold [[quality]] ingredients, preferably a type of smoked [[Fish]] or an [[Artisan Goods]] product. A few specific silver quality ingredients will work as well, but one that is normal quality will guarantee a lesser response. === Good Soup === {{Quote|Ah... that's a very pleasant soup. The produce from this valley never disappoints!}} === Neutral Soup === {{Quote|Hmm... I don't have much to say about this. It's an average soup.}} === Bad Soup === {{Quote|Um... It's actually kind of disgusting. I think I'll pass on the soup this year.}} === Worst Soup === {{Quote|Blech! This is vile! I think I'm going to be sick... I need to lie down...}} === Other Responses ===
== Movie Theater == {{Quote|I really must bring the missus out for soup and a movie!}} {{Quote|It's lovely to see economic development in the valley!}}
== Notes == * It is known that he has a wife because he "must speak to the missus" about "purchasing a vacation home here." * Putting Lewis's Purple Shorts into the soup will cause a unique reaction from Lewis and the Governor. == Portraits == {|class="article-table" style="border:9px double #797979;margin:1em 1em 0em 0em;font-size:16px" !style="text-align:center;border-bottom:3px solid #797979"|Default !style="text-align:center;border-bottom:3px solid #797979"|Examine !style="text-align:center;border-bottom:3px solid #797979"|Neutral !style="text-align:center;border-bottom:3px solid #797979"|Sick |- |[[File:{{PAGENAME}}.png|96px]] |[[File:{{PAGENAME}}_Examine.png|96px]] |[[File:{{PAGENAME}}_Neutral.png|96px]] |[[File:{{PAGENAME}}_Sick.png|96px]] |} {{Villagers}} [[Category:Villagers]] [[Category:Needs more information]] [[pl:Gubernator]] [[ru:Губернатор]] [[uk:Губернатор]]

The sound startles Kent who come into the kitchen and explains that the sound reminds him of the war and how he lost a lot of good friends in the bloody trenches. Jodi is sad because he always used to love popcorn to which Kent replies that things have changed. Jodi will ask you to say something to him. * "Jodi's to blame... she should've known better!" -25 friendship points. He'll tell you to keep quite and to stop trying to turn him against his wife. He then apologizes to Jodi since she couldn't have known that the sound would upset him. Jodi will console him and says she will try to do her best to keep his spirits up from now on. * "I know you're hurting... but don't blame your wife." +50 friendship points. He'll say you're right and apologize to Jodi since she couldn't have known the sound would upset him. Jodi says it's okay, she didn't want to upset him and she'll do her best to keep his spirits up from now on. * "(Lie) Blame me... I asked for popcorn" -50 friendship points. Kent gets angry and says "Don't lie to me! I hate lies more than anything!" And then apologizes to Jodi.  '''Cutscene video: '''https://youtu.be/daAccGf607w ==Dialogue== === Regular === "It looks like a decent day for fishing, doesn't it?" "Things haven't changed much since I've been gone. Except we have a new farmer in town." "Are you friends with my son? You probably know him better than I do..." "I wish I could have been there for him." === Festivals === '''Egg Festival''' *"I'm not a big fan of eggs myself, to tell you the truth." '''Luau''' *"Hey, good to see you." '''Dance of the Moonlight Jellies''' *"Good evening, (Name). Hope you can find some time to relax before the harvest season." == Portraits ==

{{Starbox character |caption = "... you must be in dire need of a change. The same thing happened to me... So I dropped everything and moved to the place I truly belong." |villager = yes |family = [[File:Player Icon.png|20px|link=]] [[The Player]] (Grandchild) |friends = [[File:Lewis Icon.png|20px|link=]] [[Lewis]] |work = Farmer (Deceased) }} '''Grandpa''' appears in the introduction of the game after you complete making your character. He seems to be on his deathbed, and tells the player that he has a letter for them, but only to open it when they are ready to. Through the introduction, the player opens the letter Grandpa gave them and is given the deed to the Farm.
In the top left corner of your farm, you will find grandpa's shrine. There is a note that says:
"Wait for my return at the dawn of your third year."
On Spring 1, Year 3, Grandpa will come back to evaluate the player's progress in Stardew Valley. The shrine will light up with a number of candles, the numbers of candles lit is directly linked to Grandpa's evalutation. Re-entering the house at any time will trigger a cutscene.
If all four candles are lit, the player can claim the [[Statue of Perfection]] at the shrine.
The player can be re-evaluated at any time, if they place a [[diamond]] in the Shrine. This will cause Grandpa to show up again the first day after a game load, or the first day of the next season.
Grandpa's evaluation is based on a point system, based on various milestones reached during the gameplay. There are a total of 19 available points and it takes 12 points to get the Statue of Perfection.
== Shrine Points == Money earned (highest value only) * 50,000 (1) * 100,000 (2) * 200,000 (3) * 300,000 (4) * 500,000 (5) * 1,000,000 (7) [[Achievements]] * A Perfect Collection (1) * Master Angler (1) * Full Shipment (1) * Master of the Five Ways (1) * Local Legend (1) Social * Friendship level of at least 5 with at least five villagers (1) * Friendship level of at least 8 with at least ten villagers (1) * Married with fully upgraded house (1) * Have your [[Pets|pet]] loving you (1) Other * [[Skull Key]] obtained (1) * [[Rusty Key]] obtained (1) * Have a total of 30 or more levels in skill points (1)

{{Item|Spice Berry}} }} {{tocright}} '''Jodi''' is a non-marriage [[Villager]] who lives with her husband [[Kent]] and two sons, [[Sam]] and [[Vincent]]. They live at [[1 Willow Lane]] located in the southwest corner of [[Pelican Town]] in [[Stardew Valley (location)|Stardew Valley]]. Jodi is the head of the house while her husband is away, and wishes she had more time to spend outdoors. However, most days her time is spent balancing cooking, cleaning, and shopping for the boys and herself. ==Daily Routine== === '''Spring''' === '''Tuesday''' {| class="fandom-table" |+ !Time !Place |- !06:00 PM |Leaves Caroline's Fitness Class (Pierre's Shop) |} '''Sunday''' {| class="article-table" !Time !Place |- !10:00 AM |Leaves house to Jojamart |- !11:00 AM |Goes to church at Pierre's shop |- !2.00 PM |Leaves Pierre's shop |} '''Saturday''' {| class="article-table" !Time !Place |- !09:00 AM |Goes to the Kitchen and starts washing dishes |- !01:30 PM |Exits house and stands in town square |} '''Thursday''' {| class="article-table" !Time !Place ! ! |- !01:40PM |Leaves house | | |- !05:00PM |Goes to Vincent's room | | |- !08:00PM |Leaves Vincent's room and sits on couch | | |} === '''Summer''' === '''Sunday''' {| class="article-table" !Time !Place |- |'''05:00PM''' |Sitting on couch in living room. |} '''Monday''' {| class="article-table" !Time !Place |- |'''09:00AM''' |Washing dishes |- |'''01:30PM''' |Leaves house to go to town square |- |'''04:00PM''' |Leaves town square and goes back to house |- |'''07:00PM''' |Washing dishes |} '''Tuesday''' {| class="article-table" border="0" cellpadding="1" cellspacing="1" style="width: 500px;" |- ! scope="col" |Time ! scope="col" |Place |- !'''09:00AM''' |Washing dishes |- !12:00PM - 04:30PM |Workout at Pierre's General Store. |} '''Saturday''' {| class="article-table" border="0" cellpadding="1" cellspacing="1" style="width: 500px;" |- !Time !place |- !01:30PM |Leaves house and go to town square |} === '''Fall''' === {| class="article-table" ! My goodness, that would be nice!" *"Hi. Do you get tired of people asking about your farm all the time? I think I would." *"What do I do for fun? Hmm...That's a good question. I like sleeping." *'''Exercising at Pierre's''' - "Ungh...breathe in...ungh...Breathe out." *"Vincent loves this festival...it's a joy to see him so happy." '''Luau''' *"I hope the soup is good this year." '''Dance of the Moonlight Jellies''' *"There! I just saw something glowing! Oh...it's gone." '''Festival of Ice''' *"The forest looks beautiful in the winter, doesn't it?" ==Heart Events== '''Three Hearts''' [[File:2016-03-08 00001.jpg|thumb|180x180px]] After gaining 3 hearts with Jodi the following notice and recipe will be sent in the mail. '''Four Hearts'''
Jodi will show up at the farmhouse in the morning and invite the player to eat dinner with her family at 7pm. She also asks that the player to bring a Large-mouth Bass for her casserole. Large-mouth Bass can be caught with a fishing pole in the lake to the right of Robin's house near the Mines. Cutscene video: https://youtu.be/qNSI-qCrCG0 == Portraits ==

[[File:Marrying_haley.png|400px|right|The wedding ceremony. In this instance, the player decided to marry Haley.]] {{tocright}} '''Marriage''' is a feature in [[Stardew Valley]]. There are six eligible bachelors and bachelorettes. Same-sex marriage is available. Marriage is only available after [[The Player]] has reached 10 hearts with a certain marriageable villager. For marriageable villagers, the player must first give them a [[Bouquet of Flowers|bouquet]] (bought from [[Pierre's General Store|Pierre's store]]) after reaching 8 hearts with them in order to unlock the last 2 hearts. After reaching 10 hearts, the player must purchase a [[Mermaid's Pendant|Mermaid Pendant]] from the [[Old Mariner]] for 5,000g and give it to the desired partner. The wedding will commence 3 days after proposal, unless there is an event already planned on the wedding day, in which the wedding will be delayed until the next available day. The cutscene takes place immediately after the player wakes up. A spouse will move to the player's [[Farm]] after the wedding, and a new room unique to the spouse will be added to the farmhouse. They will have a few new, unique dialogue and will sometimes help out around the farm. The gift limit of 2 gifts per week will be eliminated, however, the seven gifts per week rule will still apply. They will have 4 new heart slots. When the player reaches 12.5 hearts with their spouse, they will receive a [[Stardrop]] as a gift from their spouse. When they reach 14 hearts, they will unlock a new heart event. Spouses may help with farm chores such as: *Watering crops *Feeding livestock *Making breakfast and dinner *Repairing fences However, spouses can become unhappy if not treated well, which will result in undesirable actions, such as laying in bed all day and saying irritating things. The spouse may also become unhappy whilst walking through a house that has too many decorations, indicating that their walking pattern is being blocked. Spousal happiness and behavior are presently erratic. There were probably attempts to make each different based on personalities and may still have yet to be finalized. All the player can do presently is talk to them until the player reaches a kiss/embrace motion each day. The player may be able to talk to them more later in the day but the embrace/kiss gesture only generates one heart a day, implying the player has made their spouse happy. == Spouse Rooms == Once married, a room themed specific to the player's spouse will be added to the [[Farmhouse]] layout. The room cannot be demolished at the [[Carpenter's Shop]], but will be removed after a divorce. Decoration and furniture that came with the spouse's room also cannot be removed, but the player may add and remove other furniture of their own. A spouse can often be found spending time in their own room. Abigail's Room [[File:Abigail Spouse Room.png|left|thumb|188x188px|Abigail's Room]] [[Abigail|Abigail's]] room has ocean-themed wallpaper, a tv with a gaming console, and a fish tank. The gaming console shows her interest in video games, and is a reminder of Abigail's 2-heart event, when she plays [[Journey of the Prairie King]] with the player. The drum kit is because she plays the drums in [[Sam|Sam's]] 10-heart event. The sword represents Abigail's desire to explore the mines, as shown in her 10-heart event. The bookshelf on her wall has a skull in it, representing her interest in macabre topics, as shown in her 6-heart event. Alex's Room [[File:Alex's Spouse Room.webp|125px|left|thumb|Alex's Room]] [[Alex's]] room has a green floor and Gridball wallpaper, showing his love for the sport. Decorations include a dresser, some weights, some balls and a weight lifting bench. {{Clear}} Elliott's Room [[File:Elliott Spouse Room.png|125px|left|thumb|Elliott's Room]] [[Elliott|Elliott's]] room has a warm brown colour scheme, and is filled with books, showing his desire to be an author. There is a small model ship, representing his fondness for boats, as shown in his 10-heart event.{{Clear}} Emily's Room [[File:Emily's Spouse Room.png|left|thumb|170x170px|Emily's Room]] [[Emily|Emily's]] room has a sewing table, since she likes making clothes, and the bird that is rescued in her 4-heart event. She has a picture of the desert and a small palm tree, representing her friendship with [[Sandy]], who lives in Calico Desert. Haley's Room [[File:Haley Spouse Room.png|left|thumb|187x187px|Haley's Room]] [[Haley|Haley's]] room has a camera and a board with some photos on it, showing her passion for photography. It has a makeup table, to show that she cares about her appearance. {{Clear}} Harvey's Room [[File:Harvey spouse room.jpg|125px|left|thumb|Harvey's Room]] [[Harvey|Harvey's]] room has model airplanes and the device he uses to contact an airplane in his 8-heart event, showing his passion for airplanes. It also has books scattered around, to show that he is smart. {{Clear}} Leah's Room [[File:Leah Spouse Room.png|left|thumb|185x185px|Leah's Room]] [[Leah|Leah's]] room has a canvas, some finished paintings, and some paint pots to show Leah's love for art. {{Clear}}Maru's Room[[File:Maru Spouse Room.png|left|thumb|187x187px|Maru's room]] [[Maru|Maru's]] room has a telescope and starry wallpaper, as well as a star chart and a picture of the earth, to represent her 6-heart and 14-heart events. The robot on the floor represents her 10-heart event, and the kettle and hammer show her engineering hobby. {{Clear}} Penny's Room [[File:Penny's Spouse Room.png|left|thumb|187x187px|Penny's room]] [[Penny|Penny's]] room has two bookshelves, to show that Penny likes to read. {{Clear}}Sam's Room[[File:Samspouseroom.png|125px|left|thumb|Sam's Room]] [[Sam|Sam's]] room has a guitar and a keyboard, to show that Sam likes to play guitar, and to represent his 8-heart event. It has a computer to show that he likes video games. {{Clear}} Sebastian's Room [[File:Seb spouse room.jpg|125px|left|thumb|Sebastian's Room]] [[Sebastian|Sebastian's]] room has a large table that is presumably used to play Solarian Chronicles, the game that Sebastian plays with [[Sam]] and the player in Sebastian's 6-heart event. He has some pictures on the wall that are also in his bedroom in [[Robin|Robin's]] house, and a computer that represents his programming job. {{Clear}} Shane's Room [[File:Shane Spouse Room.png|left|thumb|187x187px|Shane's room]] [[Shane|Shane's]] room is littered with beer cans and dirty footprints, referencing his alcohol addiction. It has a TV that he presumably uses to watch gridball, which he sometimes references in his dialogue when he has high hearts with the player. {{Clear}} ==Children== If the farmhouse is upgraded to the nursery addition, there is a chance for a spouse to ask the player for children. *For opposite-sex couples, if the player agrees, a child will be born 14 days later. *Same-sex couples adopt. If the player agrees, a baby will arrive in the middle of the night 14 days later. *Refusing to have children does not affect friendship points. *A spouse will eventually ask the player again even if they deny having children the first time. *Children can be turned into doves by the [[Dark Shrine of Selfishness]] in exchange for a [[Prismatic Shard|prismatic shard]]. *Upon turning children into a doves, an [[Ancient Doll]] will attack the player inside the [[Witch's Hut]]. ==Divorce== After marriage, divorce becomes available at [[Lewis|Lewis's House]] for 50,000g. This action may be cancelled before 10 PM (when Lewis locks his door). After divorce, a spouse's title will switch from "(husband/wife) to (ex-husband/-wife). They will refuse to talk with the player and it is impossible to gain friendship points with them again, unless their memory is erased using the [[Dark Shrine of Memory]] in the Witch's Hut. [[kids|Children]] will stay with the player at the farmhouse. ==Jealousy== Spouses may become jealous and mistrustful if the player gives another marriage candidate of the same sex as the spouse a gift. This event will not trigger unless the marriage candidate in question was given a bouquet at any point in time. This event removes 30 friendship points. ==Marriage Candidates== ===Bachelors=== {| class="article-table" |- |Picture | Alex.png | Elliott.png | Harvey.png |- |Name |[[Alex]] |[[Elliott]] |[[Harvey]] |- |Picture | Sam.png |[[File:Shane.png|thumb]] | Sebastian.png |- |Name |[[Sam]] |[[Shane]] |[[Sebastian]] |} ===Bachelorettes=== {| class="article-table" |Picture | Abigail.png | Haley.png | Leah.png |- |Name |[[Abigail]] |[[Haley]] |[[Leah]] |- |Picture | Maru.png |[[File:Emily.png|thumb]] | Penny.png |- |Name |[[Maru]] |[[Emily]] |[[Penny]] |} [[Category:Gameplay]] [[Category:Villagers|#]] [[ru:Брак]] [[uk:Шлюб]]

__NOEDITSECTION__ :''See [[Characters]] for non-villager creatures and NPCs.'' [[Stardew Valley (location)|Stardew Valley]] contains a wide variety villager NPCs. All villagers have their own unique stories, which you can find out about through interaction and gaining [[Friendship]] levels, also referred to as 'hearts'. Villagers have daily routines and can be located in different parts of town depending on the weather and in-game time. Friendship can be raised by daily interactions and by giving loved or liked [[gifts]] to them, and for some villagers, opens the way for getting [[Marriage|Married]] with the player. ==

==
